  <script>
   // ============================================================
// 1. دوال apiCall و handleAndroidResult (الموحدة)
// ============================================================
	function normalizeBridgeResult(raw) {
    const parsed = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
    if (!parsed || parsed.success !== true) {
        throw new Error(parsed?.error || parsed?.message || 'استجابة غير صالحة من SQLite');
    }
    // بعض عقود Kotlin تُرجع JSONObject مباشرة (rows/stats/...) بدون غلاف data.
    // نضيف alias محلياً فقط للحفاظ على عقد الواجهة الموحد دون نسخ أو تغيير بيانات SQLite.
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parsed, 'data')) {
        parsed.data = parsed;
    }
    return parsed;
}

function invokeBridge(method, args = []) {
    if (!window.AndroidInterface || typeof window.AndroidInterface[method] !== 'function') {
        return Promise.reject(new Error('دالة AndroidInterface.' + method + ' غير متاحة في إصدار التطبيق الحالي'));
    }
    try {
        return Promise.resolve(normalizeBridgeResult(window.AndroidInterface[method](...args)));
    } catch (e) {
        return Promise.reject(new Error(e?.message || 'فشل استدعاء قاعدة البيانات'));
    }
}

function apiCall(action, params = {}) {
    const p = params || {};
    const json = JSON.stringify(p);
    switch (action) {
        // AndroidInterface.getStockLevelsPage: the station-scoped SQLite page contract used for the complete stock-level view.
        case 'loadPage':
        case 'getInventorySummary':
        case 'getLowStockProducts':
        case 'getInventoryCharts':
        case 'getStockValues':
        case 'filterInventory':
        case 'advancedFilter':
        case 'searchStock':
            return invokeBridge('getStockLevelsPage', [json]);
        case 'getWarehouses':
            return invokeBridge('getWarehouses', [json]);
        case 'getCategories':
            return invokeBridge('getCategories');
        case 'getInventoryAlerts':
        case 'getAlerts':
            return invokeBridge('getStockAlertRecords', [json]);
        case 'getMovements':
            return invokeBridge('getInventoryMovementPage', [json]);
        case 'addProduct':
            return invokeBridge('addProduct', [json]);
        case 'getWetStockPage':
            return invokeBridge('getWetStockPage', [json]);
        case 'getDryStockPage':
            return invokeBridge('getDryStockPage', [json]);
        case 'getForecourtSnapshot':
            return invokeBridge('getForecourtSnapshot', [json]);
        case 'createPurchaseOrder':
            return invokeBridge('createPurchaseOrder', [json]);
        case 'runInventoryAnomalyDetection':
            return invokeBridge('runInventoryAnomalyDetection', [json]);
        case 'getDemandForecast':
            return invokeBridge('getDemandForecast', [json]);
        case 'getShiftReconciliation':
            return invokeBridge('getShiftReconciliation', [json]);
        case 'insertDipReading':
            return invokeBridge('insertDipReading', [json]);
        default:
            return Promise.reject(new Error('الإجراء غير مدعوم: ' + action));
    }
}

// ============================================================
// 2. دوال مساعدة// ============================================================
// 2. دوال مساعدة (Toast, Loading)
// ============================================================
function escapeHtml(value) { const d=document.createElement('div'); d.textContent=String(value ?? ''); return d.innerHTML; }

function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
    const icon = type === 'success' ? 'success' : type === 'error' ? 'error' : 'warning';
    Swal.fire({
        title: type === 'success' ? '✅ نجاح' : type === 'error' ? '❌ خطأ' : '⚠️ تنبيه',
        text: message,
        icon: icon,
        timer: 3000,
        showConfirmButton: false,
        position: 'top-end',
        toast: true
    });
}

function showLoading(show) {
    document.getElementById('loadingIndicator').style.display = show ? 'flex' : 'none';
}

// 4. دوال التهيئة والتبويبات
// ============================================================
function switchSection(sectionId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('active'));
    document.getElementById(sectionId + 'Section').classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelector(`.menu-item[data-section="${sectionId}"]`).classList.add('active');
    
    // تحميل البيانات حسب القسم
    if (sectionId === 'forecourt') loadForecourt();
    if (sectionId === 'dryStock') loadDryStock();
    if (sectionId === 'wetStock') loadWetStock();
    if (sectionId === 'movements') loadMovements();
    if (sectionId === 'values') loadStockValues();
    if (sectionId === 'alerts') loadAlerts();
}

function toggleTheme(theme) {
    if (theme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
        localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark');
        document.querySelector('#darkModeToggle i').className = 'fas fa-sun';
    } else {
        document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
        localStorage.setItem('theme', 'light');
        document.querySelector('#darkModeToggle i').className = 'fas fa-moon';
    }
}

function loadSavedTheme() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (saved === 'dark') toggleTheme('dark');
}

function goToMain() {
    window.location.href = '../main.html';
}

// ============================================================
// 5. تحميل البيانات الأساسية
// ============================================================
async function loadInitialData() {
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('loadPage', { stock_type:'all', limit:500 });
        if (!result || result.success !== true) throw new Error(result?.message || result?.error || 'فشل تحميل بيانات المخزون');
        applyPageData(result.data || {});
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error loading stock levels:', e);
        showToast(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل بيانات المخزون من SQLite', 'error');
        clearPageData();
        return false;
    } finally {
        showLoading(false);
    }
}

async function createReorderPO(productId, quantity) {
    if (quantity <= 0) { showToast('الصنف ليس تحت حد إعادة الطلب', 'info'); return; }
    try { const result = await apiCall('createPurchaseOrder', {item_type:'PRODUCT', item_id:productId, quantity}); if (result.success) showToast('تم إنشاء أمر شراء مسودة فعليًا', 'success'); else throw new Error(result.error || 'تعذر إنشاء أمر الشراء'); } catch (e) { showToast(e.message, 'error'); }
}

async function runAnomalyScan() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('runInventoryAnomalyDetection', {});
        if (!result || result.success === false) throw new Error(result?.message || result?.error || 'تعذر تنفيذ فحص الشذوذ');
        const records = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data : (result.data?.rows || result.data?.alerts || []);
        showToast(`اكتمل فحص المحطة؛ ${records.length} تنبيه جديد`, 'success');
        await Promise.all([loadInitialData(), loadForecourt(), loadAlerts()]);
    } catch (e) { showToast(e.message || 'فشل فحص الشذوذ', 'error'); }
}

async function loadForecourt() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getForecourtSnapshot', {});
        if (!result || result.success !== true) throw new Error(result?.message || result?.error || 'تعذر تحميل لقطة المحطة');
        const data = result.data || {}, sales = data.sales || {};
        document.getElementById('forecourtShift').textContent = data.shift?.shift_code || 'لا توجد وردية';
        document.getElementById('forecourtFuel').textContent = Number(sales.fuel_liters || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' لتر';
        document.getElementById('forecourtStore').textContent = Number(sales.store_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
        document.getElementById('forecourtHealth').textContent = Number(data.health_score || 0).toFixed(1) + '%';
        document.getElementById('forecourtSnapshotBody').innerHTML = `<tr><td>فواتير الوقود</td><td>${Number(sales.fuel_invoices || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td><td>فاتورة</td></tr><tr><td>فواتير المتجر</td><td>${Number(sales.store_invoices || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td><td>فاتورة</td></tr><tr><td>التنبيهات المفتوحة</td><td>${(data.alerts || []).length}</td><td>تنبيه</td></tr>`;
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        showToast(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل لوحة المحطة', 'error');
        return false;
    }
}

async function loadDryStock() {
    try {
        const categoryValue = document.getElementById('categoryFilter')?.value || 'all';
        const expiryValue = document.getElementById('expiryFilter')?.value || 'all';
        const locationValue = document.getElementById('dryStockLocation')?.value?.trim() || '';
        const filters = {
            search: document.getElementById('dryStockSearch')?.value?.trim() || '',
            category_id: categoryValue === 'all' ? 0 : Number(categoryValue),
            location_id: locationValue ? Number(locationValue) : 0,
            expiry_status: expiryValue === 'all' ? '' : expiryValue
        };
        const result = await apiCall('getDryStockPage', filters);
        if (!result || result.success !== true) throw new Error(result?.message || result?.error || 'تعذر تحميل مخزون المنتجات');
        const data = result.data || {}, k = data.kpis || {};
        document.getElementById('dryInventoryValue').textContent = Number(k.inventory_value || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
        document.getElementById('dryLowStock').textContent = Number(k.low_stock_count || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' صنف';
        document.getElementById('dryDeadStock').textContent = Number(k.dead_stock_value || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
        const rows = data.products || [];
        document.getElementById('dryProductBoard').innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(p => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(p.product_code || '')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(p.product_name_ar || p.product_name || '')}</td><td>${Number(p.quantity || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td><td>${p.nearest_expiry ? escapeHtml(p.nearest_expiry) : '—'}</td><td>${Number(p.available_serials || 0)}</td><td>${[p.track_serial == 1 ? 'سيريال' : '',p.track_batch == 1 ? 'دفعة' : '',p.track_expiry == 1 ? 'صلاحية' : ''].filter(Boolean).join('، ') || '—'}</td><td><button class="apply-btn" onclick="showProductBatches(${Number(p.product_id)})">عرض الدفعات</button><button class="apply-btn apply-btn-secondary" onclick="createReorderPO(${Number(p.product_id)},${Math.max(0,Number(p.reorder_point||p.minimum_stock||0)-Number(p.quantity||0))})">طلب</button></td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="7">لا توجد منتجات فعلية للمحطة</td></tr>';
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        showToast(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل مخزون المنتجات', 'error');
        return false;
    }
}

async function showProductBatches(productId) {
    try { const result = await invokeBridge('getProductBatches', [JSON.stringify({product_id: productId})]); const rows = (result.data || []).map(b => `${b.lot_number || 'بدون رقم'} — ${Number(b.quantity || 0).toLocaleString('en')} وحدة — ${b.expiry_date || 'بدون صلاحية'}`).join('<br>'); await Swal.fire({title:'دفعات FEFO',html:rows || 'لا توجد دفعات متاحة',confirmButtonText:'إغلاق'}); } catch (e) { showToast(e.message, 'error'); }
}

async function loadWetStock() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getWetStockPage', {});
        if (!result || result.success !== true) throw new Error(result?.message || result?.error || 'تعذر تحميل مخزون الوقود');
        const data = result.data || {}, kpis = data.kpis || {};
        document.getElementById('wetTotalLiters').textContent = Number(kpis.total_liters || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' لتر';
        document.getElementById('wetUllage').textContent = Number(kpis.ullage_liters || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' لتر';
        document.getElementById('wetShiftSales').textContent = Number(kpis.current_shift_liters || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' لتر';
        document.getElementById('wetShiftAmount').textContent = Number(kpis.current_shift_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
        const rows = data.tanks || [];
        document.getElementById('wetTankBoard').innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.map(t => {
            const ullage = Number(t.capacity_liters || 0) - Number(t.current_liters || 0), water = Number(t.water_level_mm || 0);
            return `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(t.tank_name || t.tank_code || '')}</td><td>${Number(t.capacity_liters||0).toLocaleString('en')} لتر</td><td>${Number(t.current_liters||0).toLocaleString('en')} لتر</td><td>${Number(t.standard_liters_15c||0).toLocaleString('en')} لتر (VCF ${Number(t.vcf||1).toFixed(5)})</td><td class="${ullage < Number(t.capacity_liters||0)*.2 ? 'risk-critical':''}">${ullage.toLocaleString('en')} لتر</td><td>${t.temperature_c == null ? '—' : Number(t.temperature_c).toFixed(1)+' °م'}</td><td class="${water > 50 ? 'risk-critical':''}">${water.toLocaleString('en')} ملم</td><td>${Number(t.active_pumps||0)} نشطة / ${Number(t.inactive_pumps||0)} متوقفة</td><td><button class="apply-btn" onclick="recordWetDip(${Number(t.tank_id)})">تسجيل غمس</button><button class="apply-btn apply-btn-secondary" onclick="reconcileWetTank(${Number(t.tank_id)})">تسوية</button></td></tr>`;
        }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="9">لا توجد خزانات أو قراءات فعلية للمحطة</td></tr>';
        const recs = data.last_reconciliations || [];
        document.getElementById('wetReconciliationRows').innerHTML = recs.length ? recs.map(r => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(r.shift_id)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(r.tank_name || r.tank_code || '')}</td><td>${Number(r.expected_liters||0).toLocaleString('en')} لتر</td><td>${Number(r.actual_liters||0).toLocaleString('en')} لتر</td><td>${Number(r.variance_liters||0).toFixed(2)} لتر</td><td>${Number(r.variance_pct||0).toFixed(2)}%</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="6">لا توجد تسويات ورديات</td></tr>';
        return true;
    } catch (e) {
        showToast(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل مخزون الوقود', 'error');
        return false;
    }
}

async function recordWetDip(tankId) {
    const result = await Swal.fire({ title:'تسجيل غمس', html:'<input id="dipCm" class="swal2-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="قراءة الغمس (سم)"><input id="dipLiters" class="swal2-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="الحجم المعاير (لتر)"><input id="dipReason" class="swal2-input" placeholder="سبب الفارق عند الحاجة">', focusConfirm:false, showCancelButton:true, confirmButtonText:'حفظ', cancelButtonText:'إلغاء', preConfirm:() => ({tank_id:tankId,dip_cm:Number(document.getElementById('dipCm').value),dip_liters:Number(document.getElementById('dipLiters').value),reason_code:document.getElementById('dipReason').value}) });
    if (!result.isConfirmed) return;
    try { await apiCall('insertDipReading', result.value); showToast('تم تسجيل قراءة الغمس فعليًا', 'success'); await loadWetStock(); } catch (e) { showToast(e.message, 'error'); }
}

async function reconcileWetTank(tankId) {
    const result = await Swal.fire({ title:'تسوية الخزان للوردية الحالية', html:'<input id="reconShift" class="swal2-input" type="number" min="1" placeholder="معرف الوردية"><input id="reconActual" class="swal2-input" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="القراءة الختامية (لتر)"><input id="reconCause" class="swal2-input" placeholder="سبب الفارق عند الحاجة"><textarea id="reconNotes" class="swal2-textarea" placeholder="ملاحظات التسوية"></textarea>', focusConfirm:false, showCancelButton:true, confirmButtonText:'حفظ التسوية', cancelButtonText:'إلغاء', preConfirm:() => ({shift_id:Number(document.getElementById('reconShift').value),tank_id:tankId,actual_liters:Number(document.getElementById('reconActual').value),cause:document.getElementById('reconCause').value,notes:document.getElementById('reconNotes').value}) });
    if (!result.isConfirmed) return;
    try { await invokeBridge('submitShiftReconciliation', [JSON.stringify(result.value)]); showToast('تم احتساب التسوية وحفظ الفارق', 'success'); await loadWetStock(); } catch (e) { showToast(e.message, 'error'); }
}

function applyPageData(data) {
    const stats = data.stats || {};
    document.getElementById('totalInventoryValue').textContent = Number(stats.total_value || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
    document.getElementById('inventoryTrend').textContent = 'إجمالي الكمية الفعلية: ' + Number(stats.total_quantity || 0).toLocaleString('en');
    document.getElementById('lowStockCount').textContent = Number(stats.low_stock || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' عنصر';
    document.getElementById('criticalCount').textContent = 'حرج: ' + Number(stats.critical_stock || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' عنصر';
    document.getElementById('expiredValue').textContent = Number(stats.expired_value || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
    document.getElementById('expiryTrend').textContent = 'القيمة الفعلية من قاعدة البيانات';
    document.getElementById('turnoverRate').textContent = Number(stats.turnover_rate || 0).toFixed(2) + ' مرة';
    document.getElementById('turnoverStatus').textContent = 'دوران سنوي تقديري من استهلاك آخر 30 يوماً';

    allWarehouses = data.warehouses || [];
    allCategories = data.category_options || [];
    allProducts = data.products || [];
    allStockValues = data.values_rows || [];
    allAlerts = data.alerts || [];
    populateWarehouseDropdowns();
    populateCategoryDropdowns();
    populateFuelTypes(data.fuel_types || []);
    populateProductQueryOptions(allProducts);
    populateLowStockTable(data.low_stock_rows || []);
    populateValuesTable(allStockValues);
    populateAlertsTable(allAlerts);
    updateMovementChart(data.movement_series || []);
    updateDistributionChart(data.categories || []);
    updateTrendChart(data.trend_series || []);
    updateExpiryChart(data.expiry || {});
    populateStockIntelligence(data.intelligence || [], stats);
    updateAlertSummary(stats);
}

function populateStockIntelligence(items, stats) {
    allStockIntelligence = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
    const turnover = Number(stats.turnover_rate || 0);
    const deadValue = Number(stats.dead_stock_value || 0);
    const highRisk = Number(stats.stockout_risk_high || 0);
    const mediumRisk = Number(stats.stockout_risk_medium || 0);
    const turnoverEl = document.getElementById('smartTurnover');
    const deadEl = document.getElementById('smartDeadStock');
    const highEl = document.getElementById('smartHighRisk');
    const mediumEl = document.getElementById('smartMediumRisk');
    if (turnoverEl) turnoverEl.textContent = turnover.toFixed(2) + '×';
    if (deadEl) deadEl.textContent = deadValue.toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
    if (highEl) highEl.textContent = highRisk.toLocaleString('en');
    if (mediumEl) mediumEl.textContent = mediumRisk.toLocaleString('en');

    const tbody = document.getElementById('stockIntelligenceTableBody');
    if (!tbody) return;
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    if (!allStockIntelligence.length) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" class="text-center">لا توجد بيانات كافية للتحليل</td></tr>';
        return;
    }
    allStockIntelligence.forEach((x, idx) => {
        const risk = String(x.risk_level || 'low').toLowerCase();
        const riskText = {critical:'حرج', high:'مرتفع', medium:'متوسط', low:'منخفض'}[risk] || risk;
        const cover = Number(x.days_of_cover);
        const coverText = cover < 0 ? 'غير متاح' : (cover >= 999 ? '∞' : cover.toFixed(1) + ' يوم');
        const name = x.name || '---';
        const type = x.item_type === 'fuel' ? 'وقود' : 'منتجات';
        const reorder = Number(x.recommended_reorder || 0);
        const dead = x.dead_stock ? 'نعم' : 'لا';
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        row.innerHTML = `
            <td>${idx + 1}</td>
            <td>${escapeHtml(name)}</td>
            <td>${type}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${Number(x.current_quantity || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${Number(x.demand_30d || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td>${coverText}</td>
            <td><span class="risk-badge risk-${risk}">${riskText}</span></td>
            <td><span class="abc-badge">${escapeHtml(x.abc_class || 'C')}</span></td>
            <td class="numeric">${reorder.toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td>${dead}</td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
}

function exportStockIntelligence() {
    exportRowsAsExcel('تحليل_مستويات_المخزون', document.getElementById('stockIntelligenceTable'), 'تحليل مستويات المخزون');
}

function clearPageData() {
    populateLowStockTable([]);
    populateValuesTable([]);
    populateAlertsTable([]);
    updateMovementChart([]);
    updateDistributionChart([]);
    updateTrendChart([]);
    updateExpiryChart({active:0,soon:0,expired:0});
    populateStockIntelligence([], {});
}

function updateAlertSummary(stats) {
    document.getElementById('criticalAlert').textContent = Number(stats.critical_alerts || 0) + ' تنبيه حرج غير محلول';
    document.getElementById('expiringAlert').textContent = Number(stats.unresolved_count || 0) + ' تنبيه مخزون غير محلول';
    document.getElementById('auditAlert').textContent = 'سجلات التنبيه الفعلية: ' + Number(stats.alerts_count || 0);
}

async function loadWarehouses() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getWarehouses', {});
        if (result.success) {
            allWarehouses = result.data || [];
            populateWarehouseDropdowns();
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error loading warehouses:', e);
        // بيانات تجريبية
        allWarehouses = [];
        populateWarehouseDropdowns();
    }
}

function populateWarehouseDropdowns() {
    const selects = ['warehouseFilter', 'addWarehouse'];
    selects.forEach(id => {
        const sel = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!sel) return;
        const currentVal = sel.value;
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر المخزن</option>';
        allWarehouses.forEach(w => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = w.warehouse_id || w.id;
            opt.textContent = w.warehouse_name || w.name;
            sel.appendChild(opt);
        });
        if (currentVal) sel.value = currentVal;
    });
}

async function loadCategories() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getCategories', {});
        if (result.success) {
            allCategories = result.data || [];
            populateCategoryDropdowns();
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error loading categories:', e);
        allCategories = [];
        populateCategoryDropdowns();
    }
}

function populateCategoryDropdowns() {
    const selects = ['categoryFilter', 'addCategory'];
    selects.forEach(id => {
        const sel = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!sel) return;
        const currentVal = sel.value;
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر الفئة</option>';
        allCategories.forEach(c => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = c.category_id || c.id;
            opt.textContent = c.category_name || c.name;
            sel.appendChild(opt);
        });
        if (currentVal) sel.value = currentVal;
    });
}

	    try {

	            document.getElementById('totalInventoryValue').textContent =
	                Number(stats.total_value || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' ريال';
	            document.getElementById('inventoryTrend').textContent = 'تغطية ' + Number(stats.total_quantity || 0).toLocaleString('en') + ' وحدة فعلية';

	                (stats.low_stock || 0) + ' منتج';
	            document.getElementById('criticalCount').textContent =

        console.error('Error loading inventory summary:', e);
    }
}

// ============================================================
// 7. تحميل المنتجات المنخفضة
// ============================================================
async function loadLowStockProducts() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getLowStockProducts', { stock_type:'all', limit:500 });
        if (!result || result.success === false) throw new Error(result?.message || result?.error || 'تعذر جلب مستويات المخزون');
        const rows = (result.data || {}).low_stock_rows || (result.data || {}).rows || [];
        populateLowStockTable(rows);
        return rows;
    } catch (e) {
        populateLowStockTable([]);
        throw e;
    }
}

function populateLowStockTable(products) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('lowStockTableBody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    if (!products || products.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center">✅ لا توجد منتجات تحت الحد الأدنى</td></tr>';
        return;
    }
    products.forEach((p, idx) => {
	        const onHand = Number(p.quantity ?? p.quantity_on_hand ?? 0);
	        const minimum = Number(p.minimum_stock ?? p.min_stock_level ?? 0);
	        const shortage = Math.max(0, minimum - onHand);
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        row.setAttribute('data-id', p.product_id || p.id);
        row.onclick = function() { selectRow(this); };
        row.innerHTML = `
            <td>${idx + 1}</td>
            <td>${p.product_code || '---'}</td>
            <td>${p.product_name || '---'}</td>
	            <td class="numeric">${onHand.toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${minimum.toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td class="numeric" style="color: var(--error); font-weight: bold;">${shortage.toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td>
                <button class="action-btn action-btn-success" onclick="event.stopPropagation();createOrder(${p.product_id || p.id}, '${p.product_name || ''}')">
                    <i class="fas fa-shopping-cart"></i> طلب
                </button>
            </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
}

function selectRow(row) {
    document.querySelectorAll('#lowStockTableBody tr').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('selected'));
    row.classList.add('selected');
}

async function loadAlertsData() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getInventoryAlerts', { limit:500 });
        if (result.success) {
            const data = result.data || {};
            allAlerts = data.rows || data.alerts || [];
            populateAlertsTable(allAlerts);
            updateAlertSummary(data.statistics || data.stats || {});
        }
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
}

// 9. تحميل بيانات الرسوم البيانية
// ============================================================
async function loadChartsData() {
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getInventoryCharts', { limit:500 });
        if (result.success) {
            const data = result.data || {};
            updateMovementChart(data.movement_series || []);
            updateDistributionChart(data.categories || []);
            updateTrendChart(data.trend_series || []);
            updateExpiryChart(data.expiry || {});
        }
    } catch (e) { console.error('Error loading charts data:', e); }
}

function updateMovementChart(data) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('movementChart').getContext('2d');
    if (chartInstances.movement) chartInstances.movement.destroy();
    chartInstances.movement = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: data.map(d => d.date || d.day || ''),
            datasets: [{
                label: 'صافي الحركة اليومية',
                data: data.map(d => d.value ?? d.total_value ?? 0),
                borderColor: '#007ACC',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 122, 204, 0.1)',
                tension: 0.3,
                fill: true,
                borderWidth: 2
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: { display: false }
            },
            scales: {
                y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' } },
                x: { grid: { display: false } }
            }
        }
    });
}

function updateDistributionChart(data) {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('distributionChart').getContext('2d');
    if (chartInstances.distribution) chartInstances.distribution.destroy();
    const colors = ['#4B0082', '#007ACC', '#4CAF50', '#FFC107', '#FF5722', '#9C27B0', '#3F51B5', '#009688'];
    chartInstances.distribution = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
            labels: data.map(d => d.category || d.category_name || ''),
            datasets: [{
                data: data.map(d => d.value ?? d.total_value ?? 0),
                backgroundColor: colors.slice(0, data.length),
                borderWidth: 1
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    position: 'left',
                    labels: { font: { family: 'Cairo' }, boxWidth: 12, padding: 12 }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

function updateTrendChart(data) {

async function loadMovements() {
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getMovements', { limit:100 });
        if (result.success) {
            const rows = (result.data || {}).rows || [];
            allMovements = rows;
            populateMovementsTable(rows);
        }
    } catch(e) { populateMovementsTable([]); }
    finally { showLoading(false); }
}

function populateMovementsTable(movements) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('movementsTableBody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    if (!movements || movements.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center">لا توجد حركات لعرضها</td></tr>';
        return;
    }
    movements.slice(0, 50).forEach((m, idx) => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        row.innerHTML = `
            <td>${idx + 1}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${m.movement_date || m.created_at || '---'}</td>
            <td>${m.product_name || '---'}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${m.movement_type === 'in' || m.movement_type === 'دخول' ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-danger'}">${getMovementLabel(m.movement_type)}</span></td>
            <td class="numeric">${(m.quantity_change || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${(m.total_cost || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${m.status === 'completed' ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-warning'}">${m.status === 'completed' ? '✅ مكتمل' : '⏳ قيد الانتظار'}</span></td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
}

function getMovementLabel(type) {
    const map = {
        'in': '📥 دخول',
        'out': '📤 خروج',
        'دخول': '📥 دخول',
        'خروج': '📤 خروج',
        'transfer': '🔄 تحويل',
        'return_customer': '🔄 إرجاع عميل',
        'return_supplier': '🔄 إرجاع مورد',
        'waste': '🗑️ هالك',
        'adjustment': '⚖️ تسوية',
        'stocktake': '📋 جرد'
    };
    return map[type] || type;
}

async function loadStockValues() {
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getStockValues', { limit:500 });
        if (result.success) {
            allStockValues = (result.data || {}).values_rows || [];
            populateValuesTable(allStockValues);
        }
    } catch(e) { populateValuesTable([]); }
    finally { showLoading(false); }
}

function populateValuesTable(values) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('valuesTableBody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    if (!values || values.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center">لا توجد بيانات للعرض</td></tr>';
        return;
    }
    values.slice(0, 50).forEach((v, idx) => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        row.innerHTML = `
            <td>${v.product_name || '---'}</td>
            <td>${v.warehouse_name || 'جميع المستودعات'}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${(v.quantity ?? v.quantity_on_hand ?? 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${(v.purchase_price ?? v.average_cost ?? 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td class="numeric">${((v.total_value ?? ((v.quantity || 0) * (v.purchase_price || 0))) || 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
}

async function loadAlerts() {
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('getAlerts', { limit:500 });
        if (result.success) {
            const data = result.data || result;
            allAlerts = data.rows || data.alerts || [];
            populateAlertsTable(allAlerts);
        }
    } catch(e) { allAlerts=[]; populateAlertsTable([]); }
    finally { showLoading(false); }
}

function populateAlertsTable(alerts) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('alertsTableBody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    if (!alerts || alerts.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center">✅ لا توجد تنبيهات</td></tr>';
        return;
    }
    alerts.slice(0, 50).forEach((a, idx) => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        const statusClass = a.is_resolved ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-warning';
        const statusText = a.is_resolved ? '✅ محلول' : '⏳ قيد المعالجة';
        row.innerHTML = `
            <td>${idx + 1}</td>
            <td>${a.product_name || '---'}</td>
            <td>${a.alert_type || '---'}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${a.alert_level === 'critical' ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-warning'}">${a.alert_level || 'normal'}</span></td>
            <td>${a.created_at || '---'}</td>
            <td><span class="badge ${statusClass}">${statusText}</span></td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(row);
    });
}

async function applyFilters() {
    const warehouse = document.getElementById('warehouseFilter').value;
    const category = document.getElementById('categoryFilter').value;
    const dateRange = document.getElementById('dateRangeFilter').value;
    const expiry = document.getElementById('expiryFilter').value;
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('filterInventory', {
            stock_type:'all',
            warehouse_id: warehouse === 'all' ? 0 : Number(warehouse),
            category_id: category === 'all' ? 0 : Number(category),
            date_range: dateRange,
            expiry_status: expiry === 'all' ? '' : expiry,
            limit:500
        });
        if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.message || 'فشل تطبيق الفلاتر');
        applyPageData(result.data || {});
        await loadDryStock();
        showToast('تم تطبيق الفلاتر على بيانات SQLite الفعلية', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        showToast(e.message || 'خطأ في تطبيق الفلاتر', 'error');
    } finally { showLoading(false); }
}

function showAdvancedFilter() {
    document.getElementById('advancedFilterModal').style.display = 'flex';
}

async function applyAdvancedFilters() {
    const minValue = document.getElementById('minValue').value.trim();
    const maxValue = document.getElementById('maxValue').value.trim();
    const minQty = document.getElementById('minQuantity').value.trim();
    const maxQty = document.getElementById('maxQuantity').value.trim();
    const addDate = document.getElementById('addDate').value;
    if (minValue && maxValue && Number(minValue) > Number(maxValue)) return showToast('نطاق القيمة غير صحيح', 'error');
    if (minQty && maxQty && Number(minQty) > Number(maxQty)) return showToast('نطاق الكمية غير صحيح', 'error');
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('advancedFilter', {
            stock_type:'all',
            min_value:minValue ? Number(minValue) : null,
            max_value:maxValue ? Number(maxValue) : null,
            min_quantity:minQty ? Number(minQty) : null,
            max_quantity:maxQty ? Number(maxQty) : null,
            add_date:addDate || '',
            limit:500
        });
        if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.message || 'فشل تطبيق التصفية المتقدمة');
        applyPageData(result.data || {});
        closeModal('advancedFilterModal');
        showToast('تم تطبيق التصفية المتقدمة على قاعدة البيانات', 'success');
    } catch (e) {
        showToast(e.message || 'خطأ في التصفية المتقدمة', 'error');
    } finally { showLoading(false); }
}

    document.getElementById(modalId).style.display = 'none';

function toggleStockQueryFields() {
    const type = document.getElementById('searchStockType').value;
    document.getElementById('fuelQueryGroup').style.display = type === 'fuel' ? 'block' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('productQueryGroup').style.display = type === 'products' ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (type !== 'fuel') document.getElementById('searchFuelType').value = '';
    if (type !== 'products') document.getElementById('searchProductName').value = '';
}

function populateFuelTypes(items) {
    const select = document.getElementById('searchFuelType');
    if (!select) return;
    select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر نوع الوقود</option>';
    (items || []).forEach(f => {
        const option=document.createElement('option');
        option.value=f.fuel_type_id || f.id;
        option.textContent=f.fuel_name_ar || f.fuel_name || f.fuel_code || 'وقود';
        select.appendChild(option);
    });
}

function populateProductQueryOptions(items) {
    const select = document.getElementById('searchProductName');
    if (!select) return;
    select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر اسم المنتج</option>';
    (items || []).forEach(p => {
        const option=document.createElement('option');
        option.value=p.product_id || p.id;
        option.textContent=p.product_name_ar || p.product_name || 'منتج';
        select.appendChild(option);
    });
}

function showSearchModal() {
    document.getElementById('searchModal').style.display = 'flex';
    toggleStockQueryFields();
}

async function performSearch() {
    const type = document.getElementById('searchStockType').value;
    if (!type) return showToast('اختر نوع المخزون أولاً', 'error');
    const fuelId = Number(document.getElementById('searchFuelType').value || 0);
    const productId = Number(document.getElementById('searchProductName').value || 0);
    if (type === 'fuel' && fuelId <= 0) return showToast('اختر نوع الوقود', 'error');
    if (type === 'products' && productId <= 0) return showToast('اختر اسم المنتج', 'error');
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('searchStock', {
            stock_type:type,
            fuel_type_id:type === 'fuel' ? fuelId : 0,
            product_id:type === 'products' ? productId : 0,
            limit:500
        });
        if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.message || 'فشل الاستعلام');
        const data=result.data || {};
        populateLowStockTable(data.rows || []);
        populateValuesTable(data.values_rows || data.rows || []);
        closeModal('searchModal');
        showToast(`تم تنفيذ الاستعلام وإرجاع ${(data.rows || []).length} سجل فعلي`, 'success');
    } catch(e) {
        showToast(e.message || 'خطأ في الاستعلام', 'error');
    } finally { showLoading(false); }
}

async function saveNewProduct() {
    const code = document.getElementById('addCode').value.trim();
    const name = document.getElementById('addName').value.trim();
    const quantity = document.getElementById('addQuantity').value;
    const minStock = document.getElementById('addMinStock').value;
    const price = document.getElementById('addPrice').value;
    const category = document.getElementById('addCategory').value;
    const warehouse = document.getElementById('addWarehouse').value;
    
    if (!code || !name || !quantity || !minStock || !price || !category || !warehouse) {
        showToast('الرجاء ملء جميع الحقول', 'error');
        return;
    }
    showLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await apiCall('addProduct', {
            product_code: code,
            product_name: name,
            quantity: parseFloat(quantity),
            min_stock_level: parseFloat(minStock),
            purchase_price: parseFloat(price),
            category_id: parseInt(category),
            warehouse_id: parseInt(warehouse)
        });
        if (result.success) {
            showToast('تم إضافة المنتج بنجاح', 'success');
            closeModal('addModal');
            loadInitialData();
        }
    } catch (e) {
        showToast('خطأ في إضافة المنتج', 'error');
    } finally {
        showLoading(false);
    }
}

async function saveSettings() {
    const language = document.getElementById('languageSetting').value;
    const theme = document.getElementById('themeSetting').value;
    const autoRefresh = document.getElementById('autoRefreshSetting').value;
    localStorage.setItem('inventory_language', language);
    localStorage.setItem('inventory_auto_refresh', autoRefresh);
    if (theme === 'dark') toggleTheme('dark'); else toggleTheme('light');
    closeModal('settingsModal');
    showToast('تم حفظ تفضيلات الواجهة محلياً', 'success');
}

function xmlEscape(value) {
    return String(value ?? '').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&apos;');
}
function exportRowsAsExcel(filename, table, title) {
    if (!table) return showToast('الجدول غير موجود', 'error');
    const rows = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tr')).map(row =>
        Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('th,td')).map(cell => cell.innerText.trim())
    ).filter(r => r.some(Boolean));
    if (rows.length <= 1) return showToast('لا توجد بيانات فعلية للتصدير', 'warning');
    const workbook = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?mso-application progid="Excel.Sheet"?>
<Workbook xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet"
 xmlns:o="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office"
 xmlns:x="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:excel"
 xmlns:ss="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:spreadsheet">
 <Worksheet ss:Name="${xmlEscape(title).slice(0,31)}"><Table>
 ${rows.map(row => '<Row>'+row.map(cell => `<Cell><Data ss:Type="String">${xmlEscape(cell)}</Data></Cell>`).join('')+'</Row>').join('')}
 </Table></Worksheet>
</Workbook>`;
    const blob = new Blob(['\ufeff', workbook], {type:'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8'});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href=url;
    link.download=`${filename}_${businessDayDate()}.xls`;
    document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); link.remove();
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
    showToast('تم إنشاء ملف Excel فعلي من بيانات الجدول', 'success');
}

function downloadChart(chartId) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(chartId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.download = `${chartId}_${businessDayDate()}.png`;
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    link.click();
}

async function showExpiringProducts() {
    try {
        const result = await invokeBridge('getExpiringBatches', [JSON.stringify({days_ahead:30, limit:500})]);
        if (!result || result.success === false) throw new Error(result?.message || result?.error || 'تعذر جلب دفعات المنتجات');
        const payload = result.data ?? result;
        const batches = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : (payload.rows || payload.batches || payload.items || []);
        const rows = batches.map(batch => ({
            product_id: batch.product_id ?? batch.item_id ?? batch.id,
            product_code: batch.product_code || batch.sku || '—',
            product_name: [batch.product_name || batch.product_name_ar || batch.item_name || 'منتج', batch.expiry_date || batch.expiration_date ? `(الصلاحية: ${batch.expiry_date || batch.expiration_date})` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' '),
            quantity: Number(batch.quantity ?? batch.remaining_quantity ?? 0),
            minimum_stock: Number(batch.minimum_stock ?? batch.reorder_point ?? 0),
            expiry_date: batch.expiry_date || batch.expiration_date || ''
        }));
        switchSection('summary');
        const expiryHtml = rows.length
            ? `<div style="max-height:55vh;overflow:auto;text-align:right"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>المنتج</th><th>رقم الدفعة</th><th>الكمية</th><th>تاريخ الانتهاء</th></tr></thead><tbody>${batches.map(batch => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(batch.product_name || batch.product_name_ar || batch.item_name || 'منتج')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(batch.lot_number || batch.batch_number || '—')}</td><td>${Number(batch.quantity ?? batch.remaining_quantity ?? 0).toLocaleString('en')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(batch.expiry_date || batch.expiration_date || '—')}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`
            : '<p>لا توجد دفعات منتجات تنتهي خلال 30 يوماً.</p>';
        await Swal.fire({title:'الدفعات القريبة من الانتهاء',html:expiryHtml,confirmButtonText:'إغلاق',width:'min(900px, 94vw)'});
        showToast(rows.length ? `تم العثور على ${rows.length} دفعة تنتهي خلال 30 يوماً` : 'لا توجد دفعات منتجات تنتهي خلال 30 يوماً', rows.length ? 'success' : 'info');
    } catch (e) { showToast(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل المنتجات القريبة من الانتهاء', 'error'); }
}

// 15. التهيئة
// ============================================================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    loadSavedTheme();
    loadInitialData();
    loadForecourt();
    window.setInterval(loadForecourt, 30000);
    
    // أحداث التبديل
    document.getElementById('darkModeToggle').addEventListener('click', function() {
        const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
        toggleTheme(isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
    });
    
    document.getElementById('refreshBtn').addEventListener('click', async function() {
        const button = this;
        if (button.dataset.refreshing === 'true') return;
        button.dataset.refreshing = 'true';
        button.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        try {
            const activeSection = document.querySelector('.section.active')?.id || '';
            const refreshTasks = [loadInitialData(), loadForecourt()];
            if (activeSection === 'dryStockSection') refreshTasks.push(loadDryStock());
            if (activeSection === 'wetStockSection') refreshTasks.push(loadWetStock());
            const results = await Promise.all(refreshTasks);
            if (results.every(result => result === true)) {
                showToast('تم تحديث بيانات المخزون ولوحة المحطة بنجاح', 'success');
            } else {
                showToast('اكتمل التحديث جزئياً؛ تعذر تحديث قسم واحد أو أكثر. راجع رسائل الخطأ.', 'warning');
            }
        } finally {
            button.dataset.refreshing = 'false';
            button.style.pointerEvents = '';
        }
    });
    
    // أحداث القائمة الجانبية
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const sidebarToggle = document.getElementById('sidebarToggle');
    sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
        if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
            sidebarToggle.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
            sidebarToggle.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (!sidebar.contains(e.target) && e.target !== sidebarToggle) {
            sidebar.classList.remove('open');
            sidebarToggle.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
    });
    
	    // تُحدَّث البيانات من SQLite عند طلب المستخدم؛ لا توجد بيانات بديلة عند غياب الجسر.
});
  </script>

    <script src="file:///android_asset/assets-local/js/export-runtime.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

function apiCall(action, params) {
    const p = params || {};
    if (!window.AndroidInterface) return Promise.reject({ success: false, message: 'جسر Android غير متاح' });
    try {
        let raw;
        switch (action) {
            case 'getProductByBarcode': raw = AndroidInterface.getProductByBarcode(String(p.barcode || '')); break;
            case 'getResolvedProductSalePrice': raw = AndroidInterface.getResolvedProductSalePrice(JSON.stringify(p)); break;
            case 'getProducts': raw = AndroidInterface.getProducts(); break;
            case 'getPriceListRecords': raw = AndroidInterface.getPriceListRecords(JSON.stringify(p || {})); break;
            case 'getActivePriceListsForPricing': raw = AndroidInterface.getPriceListRecords(JSON.stringify(p || {})); break;
            case 'getNextInvoiceNumber': raw = AndroidInterface.getNextInvoiceNumber(); break;
            case 'completeSale': raw = AndroidInterface.completeSale(JSON.stringify(p)); break;
            case 'getDryStockPage': raw = AndroidInterface.getDryStockPage(JSON.stringify(p || {})); break;
            case 'getProductBatches': raw = AndroidInterface.getProductBatches(JSON.stringify(p || {})); break;
            case 'getAvailableSerials': raw = AndroidInterface.getAvailableSerials(JSON.stringify(p || {})); break;
            case 'getCustomers': raw = AndroidInterface.getCustomers(); break;
            case 'getPaymentTerms': raw = AndroidInterface.getPaymentTerms(String(p.applies_to || 'customer')); break;
            case 'getCurrentStationProfile': raw = AndroidInterface.getCurrentStationProfile(); break;
            case 'getStationFilePreviewDataUrl': raw = AndroidInterface.getStationFilePreviewDataUrl(String(p.uri || '')); break;
            case 'getEntityTypes': raw = AndroidInterface.getEntityTypes(); break;
            case 'getEntitiesByType': raw = AndroidInterface.getEntitiesByType(Number(p.entity_type_id || 0)); break;
            case 'getEntityDetails': raw = AndroidInterface.getEntityDetails(Number(p.entity_id || 0)); break;
            case 'searchCustomers': raw = AndroidInterface.searchParties(String(p.query || '')); break;
            case 'addCustomer': raw = AndroidInterface.addParty(JSON.stringify({ party_type_id: Number(p.entity_type_id || 1), commercial_name: p.name, commercial_name_ar: p.name, phone: p.phone, email: p.email || '', credit_limit: Number(p.credit_limit || 0), is_active: true })); break;
            case 'searchSales': raw = AndroidInterface.searchSales(JSON.stringify(p)); break;
            case 'saveReturn': raw = AndroidInterface.processSaleReturn(JSON.stringify(p)); break;
            case 'processProductSaleAdjustment': raw = AndroidInterface.processProductSaleAdjustment(JSON.stringify(p)); break;
            case 'processReturn': raw = AndroidInterface.processSaleReturn(JSON.stringify(p)); break;
            case 'searchInvoices': raw = AndroidInterface.searchInvoices(JSON.stringify(p)); break;
            case 'retrieveInvoice': raw = AndroidInterface.retrieveInvoice(String(p.invoice_number || '')); break;
            case 'salesReport': raw = AndroidInterface.salesReport(); break;
            case 'printReceipt': raw = AndroidInterface.printCurrentPage(String(p.invoice_number || '')); break;
            case 'shareInvoiceJpg': raw = AndroidInterface.shareInvoiceJpg(String(p.invoice_html || ''), String(p.phone || '')); break;
            case 'saveInvoicePdf': raw = AndroidInterface.saveInvoicePdf(String(p.invoice_html || '')); break;
            case 'printSalesReport': raw = AndroidInterface.printCurrentPageWithTitle('تقرير المبيعات'); break;
            default: return Promise.reject({ success: false, message: 'العملية غير مدعومة: ' + action });
        }
        return Promise.resolve(typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw);
    } catch (e) { return Promise.reject({ success: false, message: e.message || 'فشل استدعاء الجسر' }); }
}

// ============================================================
// جسر الردود غير المتزامنة (Async Bridge Results)
// ============================================================
const _pendingCalls = new Map();

function registerPendingCall(action, resolver) {
    if (!action || typeof resolver !== 'function') return;
    _pendingCalls.set(action, resolver);
}

function clearPendingCall(action) {
    if (!action) return;
    _pendingCalls.delete(action);
}

function handleAndroidResult(action, data) {
    const resolver = _pendingCalls.get(action);
    if (!resolver) {
        console.warn('[Android Bridge] No pending call registered for action:', action);
        return;
    }
    _pendingCalls.delete(action);
    try {
        const parsed = typeof data === 'string' ? JSON.parse(data) : data;
        resolver(parsed);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Error in handleAndroidResult:', action, e);
    }
}

// ============================================================
// 2. نظام التحميل
// ============================================================
let _loadingRefCount = 0;
let _loadingSafetyTimer = null;

function showLoading(show) {
    const el = document.getElementById('loadingIndicator');
    if (!el) return;
    if (show) {
        _loadingRefCount++;
        el.style.display = 'flex';
        el.classList.add('show');
        if (_loadingSafetyTimer) clearTimeout(_loadingSafetyTimer);
        _loadingSafetyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            _loadingRefCount = 0;
            el.style.display = 'none';
            el.classList.remove('show');
            _loadingSafetyTimer = null;
            console.warn('[Loading] Safety timeout — force hidden');
        }, 45000);
    } else {
        _loadingRefCount = Math.max(0, _loadingRefCount - 1);
        if (_loadingRefCount === 0) {
            el.style.display = 'none';
            el.classList.remove('show');
            if (_loadingSafetyTimer) { clearTimeout(_loadingSafetyTimer); _loadingSafetyTimer = null; }
        }
    }
}

function forceHideLoading() {
    _loadingRefCount = 0;
    const el = document.getElementById('loadingIndicator');
    if (el) { el.style.display = 'none'; el.classList.remove('show'); }
    if (_loadingSafetyTimer) { clearTimeout(_loadingSafetyTimer); _loadingSafetyTimer = null; }
}

// ============================================================
// 3. Toast
// ============================================================
function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
    forceHideLoading();
    const config = {
        success: { title: 'نجاح', icon: 'success' },
        error:   { title: 'خطأ',  icon: 'error'   },
        warning: { title: 'تنبيه', icon: 'warning' },
        info:    { title: 'معلومة', icon: 'info'   }
    };
    const selected = config[type] || config.success;
    Swal.fire({
        title: selected.title,
        text: message,
        icon: selected.icon,
        timer: 3000,
        showConfirmButton: false,
        customClass: { popup: 'swal-custom-popup' }
    });
}

const ALL_MODALS = [
    'salesReportModal', 'customerSearchModal', 'newCustomerModal',
    'returnModal', 'manualProductPickerModal', 'invoiceRetrieveModal',
    'returnOverlay', 'deferredPaymentModal', 'productDetailsCanvas'
];

function closeAllModals(opts) {
    const options = opts || {};
    ALL_MODALS.forEach(id => {
        const m = document.getElementById(id);
        if (m) {
            m.style.display = 'none';
            m.scrollTop = 0;
            const inner = m.querySelector('.modal-content, .return-content, .damaged-content');
            if (inner) inner.scrollTop = 0;
        }
    });
    const dbl = document.querySelector('.double-click-actions-backdrop');
    if (dbl) dbl.remove();
    if (options.restoreFocus) setTimeout(restoreEditableFocus, 50);
}

function openModal(modalId) {
    closeAllModals();
    const modal = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (!modal) return;
    modal.scrollTop = 0;
    modal.scrollLeft = 0;
    const inner = modal.querySelector('.modal-content, .return-content, .damaged-content');
    if (inner) { inner.scrollTop = 0; inner.scrollLeft = 0; }
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        modal.scrollTop = 0;
        if (inner) inner.scrollTop = 0;
    });
    setTimeout(() => {
        modal.scrollTop = 0;
        if (inner) inner.scrollTop = 0;
    }, 450);
}

function closeModal(modalId) {
    const modal = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (modal) {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        modal.scrollTop = 0;
        const inner = modal.querySelector('.modal-content, .return-content, .damaged-content');
        if (inner) inner.scrollTop = 0;
    }
    setTimeout(restoreEditableFocus, 30);
}

// 6. تطبيع الأرقام العربية

function toLatinDigits(str) {
    return String(str)
        .replace(/[\u0660-\u0669]/g, d => String.fromCharCode(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660 + 0x30))
        .replace(/[\u06F0-\u06F9]/g, d => String.fromCharCode(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06F0 + 0x30));
}

document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    const t = e.target;
    if (!t || (t.tagName !== 'INPUT' && t.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA')) return;
    if (/[\u0660-\u0669\u06F0-\u06F9]/.test(t.value)) {
        const start = t.selectionStart;
        t.value = toLatinDigits(t.value);
        try { t.setSelectionRange(start, start); } catch (_) {}
    }
}, true);

let lastEditableField = null;
document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
    const t = e.target;
    if (!t) return;
    if (t.tagName === 'INPUT' || t.tagName === 'SELECT' || t.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') {
        lastEditableField = t;
    }
}, true);

function restoreEditableFocus() {
    const t = lastEditableField;
    if (!t || !document.body.contains(t)) return;
    if (t.offsetParent === null) return;
    if (document.activeElement === t) return;
    try { t.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (_) {}
}

function toggleMode() {
    const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
    localStorage.setItem('theme', isDark ? 'light' : 'dark');
    const icon = document.getElementById('darkModeIcon');
    if (icon) icon.textContent = isDark ? '🌙' : '🌞';
}

function loadThemeSettings() {
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    if (savedTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
        document.getElementById('darkModeIcon').textContent = '🌞';
    } else {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
        document.getElementById('darkModeIcon').textContent = '🌙';
    }
}

function scannerButtonState(running) {
    const stopButton = document.getElementById('stopScanBtn');
    const toggleButton = document.getElementById('toggleScanBtn');
    if (stopButton) stopButton.style.display = running ? 'block' : 'none';
    if (toggleButton) toggleButton.innerHTML = running
        ? '<i class="fas fa-pause" style="color: #ffffff;"></i>'
        : '<i class="fas fa-play" style="color: #ffffff;"></i>';
}

function barcodeFormats() {
    if (typeof Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats === 'undefined') return undefined;
    const names = ['CODE_128', 'EAN_13', 'EAN_8', 'UPC_A', 'UPC_E', 'CODE_39', 'QR_CODE', 'ITF', 'CODABAR'];
    const formats = names.map(name => Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats[name]).filter(value => typeof value !== 'undefined');
    return formats.length ? formats : undefined;
}

function scannerConfig() {
    const config = {
        fps: 10,
        qrbox: function (viewfinderWidth, viewfinderHeight) {
            const w = Math.floor((viewfinderWidth || 300) * 0.85);
            const h = Math.floor((viewfinderHeight || 220) * 0.55);
            return { width: Math.max(80, w), height: Math.max(60, h) };
        },
        useBarCodeDetectorIfSupported: true
    };
    const formats = barcodeFormats();
    if (formats) config.formatsToSupport = formats;
    return config;
}

function initBarcodeScanner() {
    if (typeof Html5Qrcode === 'undefined') {
        showToast('مكتبة مسح الباركود غير متوفرة داخل التطبيق', 'error');
        return Promise.reject(new Error('Html5Qrcode غير متوفر'));
    }
    if (isScanning) return Promise.resolve();
    if (scannerStartPromise) return scannerStartPromise;
    if (scannerStopPromise) {
        return scannerStopPromise.then(function () { return initBarcodeScanner(); });
    }
    const reader = document.getElementById('qr-reader');
    if (!reader) return Promise.reject(new Error('حاوية معاينة الباركود غير موجودة'));

    scannerRequested = true;
    const token = ++scannerOperationToken;
    const scannerInstance = html5Qrcode || new Html5Qrcode('qr-reader', { verbose: false });
    html5Qrcode = scannerInstance;
    scannerStartPromise = (async function () {
        try {
            let cameras = [];
            try {
                cameras = typeof Html5Qrcode.getCameras === 'function' ? await Html5Qrcode.getCameras() : [];
            } catch (cameraError) {
                console.warn('Camera enumeration unavailable; using facingMode fallback', cameraError);
            }
            const list = Array.isArray(cameras) ? cameras : [];
            const selected = list.find(function (device) {
                return /back|rear|environment|خلفية/i.test(String(device && device.label || ''));
            });
            const cameraId = String(selected && (selected.id || selected.deviceId) || '').trim();
            const sources = cameraId
                ? [cameraId]
                : [{ facingMode: { exact: 'environment' } }, { facingMode: 'environment' }];
            let started = false;
            let startError = null;
            for (const source of sources) {
                try {
                    await scannerInstance.start(source, scannerConfig(), onScanSuccess, onScanError);
                    started = true;
                    break;
                } catch (error) {
                    startError = error;
                }
            }
            if (!started) throw startError || new Error('تعذر الوصول إلى كاميرا خلفية للمسح');
            if (token !== scannerOperationToken || !scannerRequested) {
                if (html5Qrcode === scannerInstance) {
                    await Promise.resolve(scannerInstance.stop()).catch(function () {});
                    if (html5Qrcode === scannerInstance) html5Qrcode = null;
                }
                return;
            }
            isScanning = true;
            flashEnabled = false;
            torchTrack = null;
            const flashButton = document.getElementById('toggleFlashBtn');
            if (flashButton) { flashButton.disabled = false; flashButton.title = 'تشغيل أو إيقاف فلاش الكاميرا'; }
            scannerButtonState(true);
            showScanNotification();
        } catch (error) {
            if (html5Qrcode === scannerInstance) {
                await Promise.resolve(scannerInstance.stop()).catch(function () {});
                if (html5Qrcode === scannerInstance) html5Qrcode = null;
            }
            isScanning = false;
            scannerRequested = false;
            scannerButtonState(false);
            console.error('Barcode scanner start failed:', error);
            const message = error && error.message ? error.message : String(error || 'تعذر تشغيل الكاميرا');
            showToast('تعذر تشغيل الكاميرا: ' + message, 'error');
            throw error;
        } finally {
            scannerStartPromise = null;
        }
    })();
    return scannerStartPromise;
}

function showScanNotification() {
    const notification = document.createElement('div');
    notification.className = 'barcode-scan-notification';
    notification.innerHTML = `
        <i class="fas fa-barcode"></i>
        <span>ستضاف المنتجات آلياً عند مسح الباركود<br>للإيقاف، اضغط على زر "إيقاف"</span>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(notification);
    setTimeout(() => { notification.remove(); }, 3000);
}

function toggleScanner() {
    if (isScanning || scannerStartPromise) {
        stopScanner();
        return;
    }
    scannerRequested = true;
    initBarcodeScanner().catch(function () {});
}

function getRunningVideoTrack() {
    const video = document.querySelector('#qr-reader video');
    const tracks = video && video.srcObject && typeof video.srcObject.getVideoTracks === 'function'
        ? video.srcObject.getVideoTracks() : [];
    return tracks && tracks[0] ? tracks[0] : null;
}

function getTorchCapabilities() {
    if (!isScanning || !html5Qrcode) return null;
    try {
        if (typeof html5Qrcode.getRunningTrackCameraCapabilities === 'function') {
            const capabilities = html5Qrcode.getRunningTrackCameraCapabilities();
            if (capabilities && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(capabilities, 'torch')) return capabilities;
        }
    } catch (error) { console.warn('Could not read html5-qrcode camera capabilities', error); }
    const track = getRunningVideoTrack();
    try { return track && typeof track.getCapabilities === 'function' ? track.getCapabilities() : null; }
    catch (error) { return null; }
}

async function waitForTorchCapabilities() {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt += 1) {
        const capabilities = getTorchCapabilities();
        if (capabilities && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(capabilities, 'torch')) return capabilities;
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 180));
    }
    return null;
}

async function toggleFlash() {
    if (!isScanning || !html5Qrcode) {
        showToast('شغّل ماسح الكاميرا أولاً', 'error');
        return;
    }
    const button = document.getElementById('toggleFlashBtn');
    const capabilities = await waitForTorchCapabilities();
    const track = getRunningVideoTrack();
    const canApplyWithScanner = typeof html5Qrcode.applyVideoConstraints === 'function';
    const canApplyWithTrack = !!(track && typeof track.applyConstraints === 'function');
    if (!capabilities && !canApplyWithScanner && !canApplyWithTrack) {
        if (button) button.title = 'الفلاش غير متاح في جلسة الكاميرا الحالية';
        showToast('الفلاش غير متاح في جلسة الكاميرا الحالية؛ يمكنك متابعة المسح أو استخدام إضاءة خارجية', 'warning');
        return;
    }
    const nextValue = !flashEnabled;
    try {
        const constraints = { advanced: [{ torch: nextValue }] };
        let applied = false;
        let lastError = null;
        if (typeof html5Qrcode.applyVideoConstraints === 'function') {
            try { await html5Qrcode.applyVideoConstraints(constraints); applied = true; }
            catch (error) { lastError = error; }
        }
        if (!applied && track && typeof track.applyConstraints === 'function') {
            try { await track.applyConstraints(constraints); applied = true; }
            catch (error) { lastError = error; }
        }
        if (!applied) throw lastError || new Error('مسار الفيديو غير متاح');
        flashEnabled = nextValue;
        if (button) button.innerHTML = flashEnabled
            ? '<i class="fas fa-bolt" style="color: var(--gold-primary);"></i>'
            : '<i class="fas fa-bolt" style="color: #ffffff;"></i>';
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Torch constraint failed:', error);
        if (button) button.title = 'تعذر تطبيق فلاش الكاميرا في هذه الجلسة';
        showToast('تعذر تطبيق الفلاش في جلسة الكاميرا الحالية', 'warning');
    }
}

function onScanSuccess(decodedText) {
    if (scanInProgress) return;
    const barcode = String(decodedText || '').trim();
    if (!barcode) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (barcode === lastScannedBarcode && now - lastScannedAt < 1500) return;

    scanInProgress = true;
    lastScannedBarcode = barcode;
    lastScannedAt = now;

    const input = document.getElementById('manualBarcodeInput');
    if (input) input.value = barcode;

    addProductByBarcode(barcode)
        .then(success => {
            if (success) {
                playScanSuccessSound();
                focusScannedProductQuantity(barcode);
                stopScanner();
            } else {
                console.log('[Scanner] Product not found; scanner remains active');
            }
        })
        .catch(() => { console.error('[Scanner] addProductByBarcode rejected'); })
        .finally(() => { scanInProgress = false; });
}

function playScanSuccessSound() {
    document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(sound => {
        try {
            sound.pause();
            sound.currentTime = 0;
        } catch (error) { console.warn('Could not stop previous audio', error); }
    });
    try {
        audioDing.pause();
        audioDing.currentTime = 0;
        audioDing.volume = 1;
        const playback = audioDing.play();
        if (playback && typeof playback.catch === 'function') {
            playback.catch(error => console.warn('Scanner sound unavailable', error));
        }
    } catch (error) { console.warn('Scanner sound unavailable', error); }
}

function focusScannedProductQuantity(barcode) {
    const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#productsTableBody tr'))
        .find(item => String(item.dataset.barcode || '') === String(barcode));
    if (row) focusAndSelectProductQuantity(row);
}

function onScanError(error) {
    /* أخطاء تحليل الإطار العادية لا تعرض إشعاراً */
}

function stopScanner() {
    scannerRequested = false;
    scannerOperationToken += 1;
    const instance = html5Qrcode;
    isScanning = false;
    flashEnabled = false;
    torchTrack = null;
    scannerButtonState(false);
    if (!instance || typeof instance.stop !== 'function') {
        html5Qrcode = null;
        return Promise.resolve();
    }
    if (scannerStopPromise) return scannerStopPromise;
    scannerStopPromise = Promise.resolve(instance.stop()).catch(function (error) {
        console.warn('Scanner stop completed with no running camera', error);
    }).finally(function () {
        if (html5Qrcode === instance) html5Qrcode = null;
        scannerStopPromise = null;
    });
    return scannerStopPromise;
}
