    updateDeliveryFeeDisplay();
    recordFuelSalePerformance('form-interactive', state.formOpenStartedAt);

    // Nozzle data is not on the critical path for enabling the remaining controls.
    if (selectedPumpId) {
        loadPumpNozzles(selectedPumpId, row ? field(row,['nozzle_id']) : '', openToken)
            .catch(error => {
                if (isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) toast(error.message || 'تعذر تحميل فوهات المضخة', true, 'form');
            });
    }

    window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) {
            loadSavedDeliveryLocationSuggestions(openToken, row);
        }
    }, 0);

    // Promotions do not need to block the initial form paint or field interaction.
    window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) {
            loadActivePromotions(row, openToken);
        }
    }, 80);
}

function localDate(d=new Date()) { return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); }
function localTime(d=new Date()) { return String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0'); }

async function loadPumpNozzles(pumpId='', selectedId='', openToken=state.formOpenSequence) {
    const nozzleEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="nozzle_id"]');
    if (!nozzleEl) return;
    const requestSequence = ++state.pumpNozzleRequestSequence;
    const key = String(pumpId || '');
    nozzleEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر الفوهة...</option>';
    nozzleEl.disabled = !key;
    if (!key || !bridge || typeof bridge.executeFuelSalesAsync !== 'function') return;
    nozzleEl.disabled = true;
    try {
        const cached = state.pumpNozzleCache[key];
        let nozzles = cached && Date.now() - cached.loadedAt < 60000 ? cached.rows : null;
        if (!nozzles) {
            const result = await invokeFuelSalesAsync('nozzles', [JSON.stringify({pump_id: Number(pumpId)})]);
            nozzles = rowsFrom(result);
            state.pumpNozzleCache[key] = { loadedAt: Date.now(), rows: nozzles };
        }
        if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken) ||
            requestSequence !== state.pumpNozzleRequestSequence ||
            String(document.querySelector('[data-key="pump_id"]')?.value || '') !== key) return;
        nozzleEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر الفوهة...</option>'
            + nozzles.map(n => '<option value="' + esc(n.id) + '" data-fuel-type-id="' + esc(n.fuel_type_id || '') + '">' + esc(n.nozzle_number||n.nozzle_code||n.id) + ' — ' + esc(n.nozzle_code||'فوهة') + '</option>').join('');
        nozzleEl.value = String(selectedId||'');
        nozzleEl.disabled = false;
    } catch (e) {
        if (isCurrentFuelForm(openToken) && requestSequence === state.pumpNozzleRequestSequence) {
            nozzleEl.disabled = false;
            toast('تعذر تحميل فوهات المضخة: ' + e.message, true, 'form');
        }
    }
}

async function refreshResolvedFuelPrice() {
    // Invalidate earlier replies even when the user clears the fuel selection.
    const seq = ++state.priceLookupSeq;
    const openToken = state.formOpenSequence;
    const f = document.querySelector('[data-key="fuel_type_id"]');
    const q = document.querySelector('[data-key="quantity"]');
    const p = document.querySelector('[data-key="price_per_liter"]');
    const t = document.querySelector('[data-key="total_amount"]');
    const customer = document.querySelector('[data-key="customer_id"]');
    if (!f || !p || !f.value || !isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) return;
    const quantity = Math.max(0.000001, numeric(q?.value)||1);
    const date = document.querySelector('[data-key="sale_date"]')?.value || localDate(new Date());
    const time = document.querySelector('[data-key="sale_time"]')?.value || localTime(new Date());
    try {
        const raw = await invokeFuelSalesAsync('resolvedPrice', [JSON.stringify({
            fuel_type_id: Number(f.value),
            quantity,
            customer_id: Number(customer?.value||0),
            transaction_time: date + ' ' + time,
            occasion_code: document.querySelector('[data-key="occasion_code"]')?.value.trim() || null
        })]);
        const resolved = dataOf(raw);
        if (seq !== state.priceLookupSeq || !isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) return;
        const price = Number(resolved?.unit_price);
        if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) throw new Error('لم يرجع محرك التسعير سعراً صالحاً');
        p.value = price.toFixed(4).replace(/0+$/,'').replace(/\.$/,'');
        p.dataset.priceSource = String(resolved?.source||'');
        p.dataset.priceSourceId = String(resolved?.source_id??'');
        if (t) t.value = (numeric(q?.value)*price).toFixed(2);
        updateDeliveryFeeDisplay();
    } catch (e) {
        if (seq === state.priceLookupSeq && isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) {
            toast('تعذر احتساب سعر الوقود الفعلي: ' + (e.message||'خطأ'), true, 'form');
        }
    }
}

function updateDeliveryFeeDisplay() {
    const quantity = Math.max(0, numeric(document.querySelector('[data-key="quantity"]')?.value));
    const price = Math.max(0, numeric(document.querySelector('[data-key="price_per_liter"]')?.value));
    const base = quantity * price;
    const feeInput = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_service_fee"]');
    const modeInput = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_fee_mode"]');
    const mode = modeInput?.value || 'exempt';
    const dependentFields = document.querySelectorAll('[data-delivery-fee-charge-dependent]');
    const needsFeeDetails = mode !== 'exempt';

    dependentFields.forEach(element => {
        element.style.display = needsFeeDetails ? '' : 'none';
    });

    if (mode === 'exempt' && feeInput) feeInput.value = '';
    const fee = mode === 'exempt' ? 0 : Math.max(0, numeric(feeInput?.value));
    const displayValue = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_fee_display_total"]');
    const summary = document.getElementById('deliveryFeeDisplaySummary');

    // Preserve the existing financial contract: the hidden numeric value is the
    // invoice total stored by MainActivity/DeliveryFeeAccounting.
    const invoiceTotal = (mode === 'add_to_sales' || mode === 'driver')
        ? base + fee
        : base;
    if (displayValue) displayValue.value = invoiceTotal.toFixed(2);

    if (!summary) return;
    if (mode === 'add_to_sales') {
        summary.value =
            'إجمالي قيمة المبيعات = ' + base.toFixed(2) + ' ريال\n' +
            'رسوم خدمة التوصيل = ' + fee.toFixed(2) + ' ريال\n' +
            'الإجمالي بعد رسوم التوصيل = ' + (base + fee).toFixed(2) + ' ريال';
        return;
    }
    if (mode === 'driver') {
        summary.value =
            'إجمالي قيمة المبيعات = ' + base.toFixed(2) + ' ريال\n' +
            'عهدة على السائق = ' + fee.toFixed(2) + ' ريال\n' +
            'الإجمالي المطلوب من العميل = ' + (base + fee).toFixed(2) + ' ريال';
        return;
    }
    if (mode === 'deduct_from_sales') {
        const netQuantity = price > 0 ? Math.max(0, quantity - (fee / price)) : quantity;
        const postedFuelAmount = netQuantity * price;
        summary.value =
            'صافي الكمية المباعة = ' + netQuantity.toFixed(3) + ' لتر\n' +
            'المبلغ المرحل = ' + postedFuelAmount.toFixed(2) + ' ريال\n' +
            'تُرحّل إلى حـ/إيرادات خدمة التوصيل للبيع = ' + fee.toFixed(2) + ' ريال';
        return;
    }
    summary.value = '';
}

function bindFuelCalculation(resolveDynamic=true) {
    const q = document.querySelector('[data-key="quantity"]');
    const p = document.querySelector('[data-key="price_per_liter"]');
    const t = document.querySelector('[data-key="total_amount"]');
    const f = document.querySelector('[data-key="fuel_type_id"]');
    const customer = document.querySelector('[data-key="customer_id"]');
    const payment = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_method"]');
    const cashName = document.querySelector('[data-key="cash_customer_name"]');
    const updateCashCustomerVisibility = () => {
        const paymentValue = String(payment?.value || 'cash').trim().toLowerCase();
        const allowsCashSale = ['cash', 'cash_payment', 'نقدي', 'نقداً'].includes(paymentValue);
        const cashSaleOption = Array.from(customer?.options || []).find(option =>
            option.value === 'cash_sale' || String(option.textContent || '').trim() === 'مبيعات نقدية'
        );
        if (cashSaleOption) {
            cashSaleOption.hidden = !allowsCashSale;
            cashSaleOption.disabled = !allowsCashSale;
        }
        if (!allowsCashSale && cashSaleOption && customer?.selectedIndex === cashSaleOption.index) {
            customer.value = '';
        }
        const option = customer?.options?.[customer.selectedIndex];
        const selectedCashSale = customer?.value === 'cash_sale' ||
            String(option?.textContent || '').trim() === 'مبيعات نقدية';
        const visible = Boolean(selectedCashSale && allowsCashSale);
        const wrapper = cashName?.closest('[data-cash-customer-group]') || cashName?.closest('.form-group');
        if (wrapper) wrapper.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
        if (cashName && !visible) cashName.value = '';
    };
    const calc = () => { if (t) t.value = (numeric(q?.value)*numeric(p?.value)).toFixed(2); };
    if (f) f.onchange = () => {
        const o = f.options[f.selectedIndex];
        if (p) p.value = o?.dataset.price || '';
        calc();
        updateDeliveryFeeDisplay();
        if (resolveDynamic) refreshResolvedFuelPrice();
    };
    if (q) q.oninput = () => { calc(); updateDeliveryFeeDisplay(); if (resolveDynamic) refreshResolvedFuelPrice(); };
    if (customer) customer.onchange = () => {
        if (customer.value === 'cash_sale' && payment) payment.value = 'cash';
        updateCashCustomerVisibility();
        const selectedCustomer = (state.saleFormLookupCache.customers || []).find(item =>
            Number(field(item,['id','party_id','customer_id'])) === Number(customer.value || 0)
        );
        const termSelect = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_terms_id"]');
        if (termSelect && !state.editing) {
            termSelect.value = preferredFuelPaymentTermId(selectedCustomer, state.saleFormLookupCache.paymentTerms || []);
        }
        updateFuelPaymentTermsVisibility();
        if (resolveDynamic) { loadActivePromotions(); refreshResolvedFuelPrice(); }
    };
    if (payment) payment.onchange = () => {
        updateCashCustomerVisibility();
        if (payment.value === 'credit' && customer?.value && !state.editing) {
            const selectedCustomer = (state.saleFormLookupCache.customers || []).find(item =>
                Number(field(item,['id','party_id','customer_id'])) === Number(customer.value || 0)
            );
            const termSelect = document.querySelector('[data-key="payment_terms_id"]');
            if (termSelect && !termSelect.value) {
                termSelect.value = preferredFuelPaymentTermId(selectedCustomer, state.saleFormLookupCache.paymentTerms || []);
            }
        }
        updateFuelPaymentTermsVisibility();
    };
    updateCashCustomerVisibility();
    const occ = document.querySelector('[data-key="occasion_code"]');
    if (occ) occ.addEventListener('change', () => refreshResolvedFuelPrice());
    calc();
    if (resolveDynamic) refreshResolvedFuelPrice();
}

/* ============================================================
   Open form
   ============================================================ */
function openForm(row=null) {
    if (!CFG.createMethod && !CFG.updateMethod) {
        toast('لا توجد عملية كتابة مدعومة لهذه الشاشة', true, 'global');
        return;
    }

    clearFormToast();
    state.editing = row;
    const rowMode = String(field(row, ['delivery_fee_mode']) || 'exempt').trim();
    const grossQuantity = Number(field(row, ['gross_quantity']));
    const grossAmount = Number(field(row, ['gross_amount']));
    const formRow = row && rowMode === 'deduct_from_sales'
        ? {
            ...row,
            quantity: Number.isFinite(grossQuantity) && grossQuantity > 0
                ? grossQuantity : field(row, ['quantity']),
            total_amount: Number.isFinite(grossAmount) && grossAmount > 0
                ? grossAmount : field(row, ['total_amount'])
        }
        : row;
    const openToken = ++state.formOpenSequence;
    state.formOpenStartedAt = fuelSalePerformanceNow();
    const deliveryBtn = $('deliveryBtn');
    if (deliveryBtn) {
        deliveryBtn.disabled = true;
        delete deliveryBtn.dataset.saleId;
        deliveryBtn.title = 'يتاح بعد حفظ عملية البيع بنجاح';
    }

    $('formTitle').textContent = row ? 'تعديل مبيعات الوقود' : 'إضافة عملية بيع وقود';
    const modal = $('formModal');
    const form = $('recordForm');

    // Reveal first; avoid doing template work or synchronous Android Bridge calls before the first paint.
    modal.classList.add('show');
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
    form.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    form.innerHTML = '<div role="status" style="grid-column:1/-1;padding:22px 8px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-secondary);font-weight:700;">جارٍ تجهيز نموذج البيع...</div>';

    state.lastSuccessfulSaleFingerprint = null;
    const prepareForm = () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) return;
        form.innerHTML = (CFG.fields || []).map(def => inputHtml(def, formRow)).join('');
        form.removeAttribute('aria-busy');

        // Give WebView one complete paint with the real input controls before any
        // synchronous JavaScript-interface/SQLite lookup is started.
        const startLookups = () => {
            if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) return;
            window.setTimeout(() => {
                if (!isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) return;
                recordFuelSalePerformance('controls-painted', state.formOpenStartedAt);
                loadSaleFormLookups(formRow, openToken).catch(error => {
                    if (isCurrentFuelForm(openToken)) toast(error.message || 'تعذر تحميل بيانات النموذج', true, 'form');
                });
            }, 0);
        };
        if (typeof window.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') window.requestAnimationFrame(startLookups);
        else window.setTimeout(startLookups, 16);
    }, 0);

    if (typeof window.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        window.requestAnimationFrame(prepareForm);
    } else {
        window.setTimeout(prepareForm, 16);
    }
}

function collectForm() {
    const payload = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('#recordForm [data-key]').forEach(el => {
        if (el.dataset.key === 'sale_id') return;
        let v = el.value;
        if (el.type === 'number') v = v==='' ? 0 : Number(v);
        payload[el.dataset.key] = v;
    });
    payload.created_at = new Date().toISOString();
    return payload;
}

function fuelSaleFingerprint(payload) {
    const stable = {...payload};
    delete stable.idempotency_key;
    delete stable.created_at;
    return JSON.stringify(stable);
}

async function saveForm() {
    if (state.isSaving) return;
    const form = $('recordForm');
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const payload = collectForm();
    payload.transaction_time = String(payload.sale_date || localDate(new Date())) + ' ' + String(payload.sale_time || localTime(new Date()));
    const customerSelection = String(payload.customer_id || '');
    const cashSaleSelected = customerSelection === 'cash_sale';
    const customerId = cashSaleSelected ? 0 : (Number(customerSelection) || 0);
    if (cashSaleSelected) payload.payment_method = 'cash';
    const deliveryFeeMode = String(payload.delivery_fee_mode || 'exempt');
    const deliveryFee = deliveryFeeMode === 'exempt' ? 0 : Number(payload.delivery_service_fee || 0);
    const deliveryLocation = String(payload.delivery_location || '').trim();
    const cashCustomerName = cashSaleSelected ? String(payload.cash_customer_name || '').trim() : '';
    if (!Number.isFinite(deliveryFee) || deliveryFee < 0) return toast('رسوم خدمة التوصيل يجب أن تكون صفراً أو أكثر', true, 'form');
    if (!['exempt','add_to_sales','driver','deduct_from_sales'].includes(deliveryFeeMode)) return toast('اختر طريقة احتساب رسوم التوصيل', true, 'form');
    if (deliveryFee > 0 && deliveryFeeMode !== 'exempt' && !deliveryLocation) return toast('أدخل موقع التوصيل قبل احتساب رسوم الخدمة', true, 'form');
    if (deliveryFee > 0 && deliveryFeeMode === 'deduct_from_sales' && deliveryFee >= numeric(payload.quantity) * numeric(payload.price_per_liter)) return toast('رسوم التوصيل يجب أن تكون أقل من قيمة المبيعات حتى تبقى كمية وقود موجبة', true, 'form');
    if (cashSaleSelected && deliveryLocation && !cashCustomerName) return toast('أدخل اسم العميل النقدي المرتبط بالتوصيل', true, 'form');
    payload.delivery_service_fee = deliveryFee;
    payload.delivery_fee_mode = deliveryFeeMode;
    payload.delivery_location = deliveryLocation;
    payload.cash_customer_name = cashCustomerName;
    payload.delivery_fee_display_total = Number(document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_fee_display_total"]')?.value || payload.total_amount || 0);
    const fingerprint = fuelSaleFingerprint(payload);
    if (!state.editing && state.lastSuccessfulSaleFingerprint === fingerprint) {
        return toast('تم حفظ هذه البيانات بالفعل. عدّل الكمية أو الحقول المطلوبة قبل إنشاء عملية بيع جديدة.', true, 'form');
    }
    if (customerId > 0) { payload.customer_id = customerId; } else { delete payload.customer_id; }
    if (payload.payment_method === 'credit' && customerId <= 0) {
        return toast('اختر عميلاً حقيقياً للبيع الآجل', true, 'form');
    }
    if (state.editing) {
        // Invoice terms are immutable; operational edits must not rewrite the original snapshot.
        delete payload.payment_terms_id;
    } else if (payload.payment_method === 'credit') {
        const termId = Number(payload.payment_terms_id || 0);
        const available = state.saleFormLookupCache.paymentTerms || [];
        if (!termId || !available.some(term => Number(term.id) === termId)) {
            return toast('اختر شرط الدفع من جدول شروط الدفع قبل حفظ البيع الآجل', true, 'form');
        }
    } else {
        delete payload.payment_terms_id;
    }
    if (!payload.shift_id) return toast('لا توجد وردية مفتوحة حالياً', true, 'form');
    if (!payload.pump_id) return toast('اختر المضخة', true, 'form');
    if (!payload.fuel_type_id) return toast('اختر نوع الوقود', true, 'form');
    if (!payload.nozzle_id) return toast('اختر الفوهة التابعة للمضخة', true, 'form');
    if (!(numeric(payload.quantity) > 0)) return toast('أدخل كمية أكبر من صفر', true, 'form');
    payload.total_amount = (numeric(payload.quantity) * numeric(payload.price_per_liter)).toFixed(2);
    if (!state.pendingIdempotencyKey) state.pendingIdempotencyKey = newIdempotencyKey();
    payload.idempotency_key = state.pendingIdempotencyKey;

    const saveStartedAt = fuelSalePerformanceNow();
    const saveButton = $('saveBtn');
    const originalSaveButtonHtml = saveButton ? saveButton.innerHTML : '';
    const originalSaveButtonDisabled = Boolean(saveButton && saveButton.disabled);
    const previousControlStates = Array.from(form.elements).map(control => ({
        control,
        disabled: Boolean(control.disabled)
    }));

    state.isSaving = true;
    previousControlStates.forEach(item => { item.control.disabled = true; });
    form.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    if (saveButton) {
        saveButton.disabled = true;
        saveButton.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
        saveButton.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> جارٍ الحفظ...';
    }
    showFormToast('جارٍ حفظ عملية البيع والتحقق من SQLite.', 'info');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
        // Allow WebView to paint the pending status before native SQLite starts.
        await new Promise(resolve => {
            const resume = () => window.setTimeout(resolve, 0);
            if (typeof window.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') window.requestAnimationFrame(resume);
            else window.setTimeout(resume, 16);
        });

        let result;
        if (state.editing && CFG.updateMethod) {
            result = await invokeFuelSalesAsync('update', [Number(idOf(state.editing)), JSON.stringify(payload)], 60000);
            const confirmedUpdate = parse(result);
            recordFuelSalePerformance('save-confirmed', saveStartedAt);
            rememberSavedDeliveryLocation(payload.delivery_location, confirmedUpdate);
            showFormToast('تم تحديث عملية البيع بنجاح بعد تأكيد SQLite.', 'success');
            closeModal(null, 'formModal');
            void reloadData().catch(refreshError => console.warn('[Fuel Sales] Background refresh failed:', refreshError));
            return;
        } else {
            result = await invokeFuelSalesAsync('save', [JSON.stringify(payload)], 120000);
            const saved = parse(result);
            const saleId = Number(saved.sale_id || saved.id || 0);
            if (!saleId) throw new Error('لم يتم استلام sale_id الحقيقي من SQLite');
            recordFuelSalePerformance('save-confirmed', saveStartedAt);
            state.lastSavedSaleId = saleId;
            state.pendingIdempotencyKey = null;
            state.lastSuccessfulSaleFingerprint = fingerprint;
            rememberSavedDeliveryLocation(payload.delivery_location, saved);
            if (deliveryFeeMode === 'deduct_from_sales') {
                // Stored quantity/total_amount are already net of the fee. Keep the form
                // on its gross basis so updateDeliveryFeeDisplay subtracts the fee once.
                const savedGrossQuantity = Number(saved.gross_quantity ?? payload.quantity);
                const savedGrossAmount = Number(saved.gross_amount ?? (payload.quantity * payload.price_per_liter));
                const savedInvoiceTotal = Number(saved.invoice_total ?? saved.delivery_fee_display_total);
                const quantityEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="quantity"]');
                const totalEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="total_amount"]');
                const displayEl = document.querySelector('[data-key="delivery_fee_display_total"]');
                if (quantityEl && Number.isFinite(savedGrossQuantity) && savedGrossQuantity > 0) {
                    quantityEl.value = String(savedGrossQuantity);
                }
                if (totalEl && Number.isFinite(savedGrossAmount) && savedGrossAmount >= 0) {
                    totalEl.value = savedGrossAmount.toFixed(2);
                }
                if (displayEl && Number.isFinite(savedInvoiceTotal) && savedInvoiceTotal >= 0) {
                    displayEl.value = savedInvoiceTotal.toFixed(2);
                }
                updateDeliveryFeeDisplay();
                state.lastSuccessfulSaleFingerprint = fuelSaleFingerprint(collectForm());
            }
            const sms = saved.sms || {};
            const isCreditSale = ['credit', 'آجل', 'credit_sale', 'credit_account']
                .includes(String(payload.payment_method || '').trim().toLowerCase());
            const smsNote = isCreditSale
                ? (sms.queued
                    ? ' — تم وضع رسالة SMS للعميل ' + (sms.customer_name || 'المحدد') + ' في طابور الإرسال'
                    : ' — لم تُجدول رسالة SMS للعميل: ' + (sms.reason || sms.message || 'سبب غير معروف'))
                : '';
            showFormToast('تم حفظ عملية البيع رقم ' + saleId + ' وتحديث المخزون' +
                (smsNote ? '\n' + smsNote.trim() : ''), 'success');
            showDeliveryAction(saleId);
            void reloadData().catch(refreshError => console.warn('[Fuel Sales] Background refresh failed:', refreshError));
            // Keep the form modal open for review; the operator closes it explicitly.
            // The refresh no longer delays visible save-success feedback.
            return;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        showFormToast(e.message || 'فشل حفظ العملية؛ لم يتم تأكيد الكتابة في SQLite.', 'error');
        showAdvancedNotification(e.message || 'فشل حفظ العملية', 'error', '❌ فشل الحفظ');
    } finally {
        previousControlStates.forEach(item => { item.control.disabled = item.disabled; });
        form.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
        if (saveButton) {
            saveButton.innerHTML = originalSaveButtonHtml;
            saveButton.disabled = originalSaveButtonDisabled;
            saveButton.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
        }
        state.isSaving = false;
        setLoading(false);
    }
}

function showDeliveryAction(saleId) {
    const button = $('deliveryBtn');
    if (!button) return;
    button.disabled = false;
    button.dataset.saleId = String(saleId);
    button.title = 'تم الحفظ؛ يمكنك إنشاء التوصيل';
}

function openDelivery(saleId) {
    const id = Number(saleId || $('deliveryBtn')?.dataset.saleId || 0);
    if (!id) return toast('احفظ عملية البيع أولاً', true, 'form');
    sessionStorage.setItem('delivery_sale_id', String(id));
    window.location.href = 'deliveries.html?sale_id=' + encodeURIComponent(id);
}

async function deleteRow(row) {
    const id = row && idOf(row);
    if (!id || !CFG.deleteMethod) return;
    if (!confirm('هل تريد تنفيذ الحذف الفعلي لهذا السجل؟')) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = await invoke(CFG.deleteMethod, [Number(id)]);
        parse(result);
        showAdvancedNotification('تم الحذف بنجاح', 'success', 'تم الحذف');
        await reloadData();
    } catch (error) {
        showAdvancedNotification(error.message||'فشل الحذف', 'error', 'فشل');
    } finally {
        setLoading(false);
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   Reload
   ============================================================ */
async function reloadData() {
    if (!CFG.listMethod) { renderCards(); return; }
    if (!bridge) { $('offlineBanner').classList.add('show'); renderCards(); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
        const result = CFG.listMethod === 'getFuelSalesPage'
            ? await invokeFuelSalesAsync('fuelSalesPage', argsForLoad(), 30000)
            : await invoke(CFG.listMethod, argsForLoad());
        state.rows = rowsFrom(result);
        state.loadedAt = new Date();
        $('offlineBanner').classList.remove('show');
        applyFilter();
    } catch (error) {
        state.rows = [];
        state.loadedAt = new Date();
        renderCards();
        toast(error.message||'فشل تحميل البيانات', true, 'global');
    } finally {
        setLoading(false);
    }
}

function openModal(event, id) {
    if (event && event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
    const el = $(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.add('show');
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
    setTimeout(updateTopBarHeight, 100);
}

function closeModal(event, id) {
    if (event && event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
    const el = $(id);
    if (!el) return;
    if (id === 'formModal') state.formOpenSequence++;
    el.classList.remove('show');
    // التحقق من عدم وجود مودالات أخرى مفتوحة قبل إزالة الكلاس
    const openModals = document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay.show');
    if (openModals.length === 0) {
        document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
    }
    setTimeout(updateTopBarHeight, 100);
}

/* ============================================================
   SIDEBAR
   ============================================================ */
function openSidebar() {
    const sidebar = $('sidebar');
    if (!sidebar) return;
    sidebar.classList.add('open');
    document.body.classList.add('sidebar-is-open');
    const toggle = $('sidebarToggle');
    if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
}

function closeSidebar() {
    const sidebar = $('sidebar');
    if (!sidebar) return;
    sidebar.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.classList.remove('sidebar-is-open');
    const toggle = $('sidebarToggle');
    if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
}

function toggleSidebar() {
    const sidebar = $('sidebar');
    if (!sidebar) return;
    if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) closeSidebar();
    else openSidebar();
}

function setupSidebar() {
    const sidebar = $('sidebar');
    const toggle = $('sidebarToggle');
    if (!sidebar || !toggle) return;
    toggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleSidebar(); });
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (sidebar.classList.contains('open') && !sidebar.contains(e.target) && !toggle.contains(e.target)) {
            closeSidebar();
        }
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
        if (!sidebar.classList.contains('open')) return;
        const t = e.target;
        if (sidebar.contains(t) || toggle.contains(t)) return;
        closeSidebar();
    }, {passive:true});
    sidebar.querySelectorAll('[data-sidebar]').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            handleSidebarAction(btn.dataset.sidebar);
        });
    });
}

function handleSidebarAction(action) {
    closeSidebar();
    switch(action) {
        case 'newSale':
            openForm();
            break;
        case 'return':
            openFuelAdjustment(null);
            break;
        case 'report':
            openReport();
            break;
        case 'home':
            goHome();
            break;
    }
}

async function populateReportFilters() {
    // جلب اسم المحطة الحالية
    try {
        if (bridge && typeof bridge.getCurrentStationProfile === 'function') {
            const result = await invoke('getCurrentStationProfile', []);
            const profile = dataOf(result);
            const nameEl = $('reportStationName');
            if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = profile?.station_name_ar || profile?.station_name || '—';
        }
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
        if (bridge && typeof bridge.getFuelTypes === 'function') {
            const result = await invoke('getFuelTypes', []);
            const types = rowsFrom(result);
            state.fuelTypesCache = types;
            const sel = $('reportFuelType');
            if (sel) {
                sel.innerHTML = '<option value="0">الكل</option>'
                    + types.map(t => '<option value="' + esc(t.fuel_type_id || t.id || '') + '">' + esc(t.fuel_name_ar || t.fuel_name || 'وقود') + '</option>').join('');
            }
        }
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
        if (bridge && typeof bridge.getPumps === 'function') {
            const result = await invoke('getPumps', []);
            const pumps = rowsFrom(result);
            state.pumpsCache = pumps;
            const sel = $('reportPump');
            if (sel) {
                sel.innerHTML = '<option value="0">الكل</option>'
                    + pumps.map(p => '<option value="' + esc(p.pump_id || p.id || '') + '">' + esc(p.pump_name_ar || p.pump_name || p.pump_code || ('مضخة ' + (p.pump_number || ''))) + '</option>').join('');
            }
        }
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
        if (bridge && typeof bridge.getShifts === 'function') {
            const result = await invoke('getShifts', []);
            const shifts = rowsFrom(result);
            state.shiftsCache = shifts;
            const sel = $('reportShift');
            if (sel) {
                sel.innerHTML = '<option value="0">الكل</option>'
                    + shifts.map(s => '<option value="' + esc(s.shift_id || s.id || '') + '">' + esc(s.shift_code || ('#' + (s.shift_id || s.id))) + ' — ' + esc(s.shift_date || '') + '</option>').join('');
            }
        }
    } catch (_) {}
}

function openReport() {
    setDateDefaults();
    const results = $('reportResults');
    if (results) {
        results.style.display = 'none';
        results.innerHTML = '';
    }
    state.reportRows = [];
    state.reportMeta = null;
    populateReportFilters();
    openModal(null, 'reportModal');
}

function readReportFilters() {
    return {
        from_date: ($('reportFrom')?.value || '').trim(),
        to_date: ($('reportTo')?.value || '').trim(),
        fuel_type_id: Number($('reportFuelType')?.value || 0),
        pump_id: Number($('reportPump')?.value || 0),
        payment_method: ($('reportPayment')?.value || '').trim(),
        shift_id: Number($('reportShift')?.value || 0)
    };
}

async function fetchAllForReport(filters) {
    const MAX_ROWS = 5000;
    const PAGE_SIZE = 100;
    let allRows = [];
    let offset = 0;
    let total = 0;
    let iterations = 0;
    const maxIter = Math.ceil(MAX_ROWS / PAGE_SIZE);

    while (iterations < maxIter) {
        const params = {
            limit: PAGE_SIZE,
            offset: offset,
            search: ($('searchInput')?.value || '').trim()
        };
        if (filters.from_date) params.from_date = filters.from_date;
        if (filters.to_date) params.to_date = filters.to_date;
        if (filters.fuel_type_id > 0) params.fuel_type_id = filters.fuel_type_id;
        if (filters.pump_id > 0) params.pump_id = filters.pump_id;
        if (filters.payment_method) params.payment_method = filters.payment_method;
        if (filters.shift_id > 0) params.shift_id = filters.shift_id;

        let result;
        try {
            result = await invoke('getFuelSalesPage', [JSON.stringify(params)]);
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('[Report Fetch]', err);
            break;
        }
        const parsed = dataOf(result) || {};
        const rows = Array.isArray(parsed.rows) ? parsed.rows : [];
        total = Number(parsed.total_count || 0);
        if (rows.length === 0) break;
        allRows = allRows.concat(rows);
        offset += rows.length;
        if (offset >= total) break;
        iterations++;
    }
    return {rows: allRows, total};
}

function aggregate(rows, keyFn) {
    const map = new Map();
    rows.forEach(row => {
        const key = keyFn(row) || 'غير محدد';
        if (!map.has(key)) {
            map.set(key, {key: key, count: 0, quantity: 0, total_amount: 0, returned: 0, damaged: 0});
        }
        const agg = map.get(key);
        agg.count += 1;
        agg.quantity += numeric(row.quantity);
        agg.total_amount += numeric(row.total_amount);
        agg.returned += numeric(row.returned_quantity);
        agg.damaged += numeric(row.damaged_quantity);
    });
    return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a,b) => b.total_amount - a.total_amount);
}

function aggregateDaily(rows) {
    const map = new Map();
    rows.forEach(row => {
        const day = String(row.sale_date || '').trim() || 'بدون تاريخ';
        if (!map.has(day)) {
            map.set(day, {key: day, count: 0, quantity: 0, total_amount: 0});
        }
        const agg = map.get(day);
        agg.count += 1;
        agg.quantity += numeric(row.quantity);
        agg.total_amount += numeric(row.total_amount);
    });
    return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a,b) => String(b.key).localeCompare(String(a.key)));
}

function buildReportView(rows, meta) {
    const type = state.reportType || 'summary';
    const metaHtml = '<div class="report-meta">'
        + 'من ' + esc(meta.from_date || '—') + ' إلى ' + esc(meta.to_date || '—')
        + ' • ' + rows.length + ' سجل'
        + '</div>';

    const totalQuantity = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.quantity), 0);
    const totalAmount = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.total_amount), 0);
    const totalReturned = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.returned_quantity), 0);
    const totalDamaged = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.damaged_quantity), 0);
    const cashRows = rows.filter(r => paymentType(r) === 'cash');
    const creditRows = rows.filter(r => paymentType(r) === 'credit');
    const cashTotal = cashRows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.total_amount), 0);
    const creditTotal = creditRows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.total_amount), 0);

    const headerHtml = '<div class="report-header">'
        + '<i class="fas fa-chart-bar"></i> '
        + esc(REPORT_TYPE_LABELS[type] || 'تقرير')
        + '</div>' + metaHtml;

    const summaryHtml = '<div class="report-summary-grid">'
        + '<div class="report-summary-card"><span class="label">عدد السجلات</span><span class="value">' + rows.length.toLocaleString('ar') + '</span></div>'
        + '<div class="report-summary-card"><span class="label">إجمالي اللترات</span><span class="value">' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</span></div>'
        + '<div class="report-summary-card"><span class="label">إجمالي المبالغ</span><span class="value">' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</span></div>'
        + '<div class="report-summary-card"><span class="label">صافي المرتجع/التالف</span><span class="value">' + (totalReturned + totalDamaged).toFixed(2) + '</span></div>'
        + '</div>';

    if (!rows.length) {
        return headerHtml + summaryHtml + '<div class="report-no-data"><i class="fas fa-inbox"></i>لا توجد بيانات مطابقة للفلاتر المحددة</div>';
    }

    let bodyHtml = '';

    if (type === 'summary') {
        bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>البيان</th><th>القيمة</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي مبيعات الكاش</td><td>' + cashTotal.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>عدد عمليات الكاش</td><td>' + cashRows.length.toLocaleString('ar') + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي مبيعات الآجل</td><td>' + creditTotal.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>عدد عمليات الآجل</td><td>' + creditRows.length.toLocaleString('ar') + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي الكمية (لتر)</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي المرتجع (لتر)</td><td>' + totalReturned.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي التالف (لتر)</td><td>' + totalDamaged.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>متوسط السعر للتر</td><td>' + (totalQuantity > 0 ? (totalAmount / totalQuantity).toFixed(2) : '0.00') + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>متوسط قيمة العملية</td><td>' + (rows.length > 0 ? (totalAmount / rows.length).toFixed(2) : '0.00') + '</td></tr>'
            + '</tbody></table></div>';
    } else if (type === 'by_fuel_type') {
        const agg = aggregate(rows, r => r.fuel_name_ar || r.fuel_name || ('وقود ' + (r.fuel_type_id || '')));
        bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>نوع الوقود</th><th>عدد العمليات</th><th>الكمية (لتر)</th><th>المبلغ</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + agg.map(a => '<tr><td>' + esc(a.key) + '</td><td>' + a.count + '</td><td>' + a.quantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + a.total_amount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>الإجمالي</td><td>' + rows.length + '</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>';
    } else if (type === 'by_pump') {
        const agg = aggregate(rows, r => r.pump_name_ar || r.pump_name || r.pump_code || ('مضخة ' + (r.pump_id || '')));
        bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>المضخة</th><th>عدد العمليات</th><th>الكمية (لتر)</th><th>المبلغ</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + agg.map(a => '<tr><td>' + esc(a.key) + '</td><td>' + a.count + '</td><td>' + a.quantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + a.total_amount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>الإجمالي</td><td>' + rows.length + '</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>';
    } else if (type === 'by_payment') {
        const agg = aggregate(rows, r => translateFieldValue('payment_method', r.payment_method) || 'غير محدد');
        bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>طريقة الدفع</th><th>عدد العمليات</th><th>الكمية (لتر)</th><th>المبلغ</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + agg.map(a => '<tr><td>' + esc(a.key) + '</td><td>' + a.count + '</td><td>' + a.quantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + a.total_amount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>الإجمالي</td><td>' + rows.length + '</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>';
    } else if (type === 'by_shift') {
        const agg = aggregate(rows, r => r.shift_code || r.shift_name || ('وردية #' + (r.shift_id || '')));
        bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>الوردية</th><th>عدد العمليات</th><th>الكمية (لتر)</th><th>المبلغ</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + agg.map(a => '<tr><td>' + esc(a.key) + '</td><td>' + a.count + '</td><td>' + a.quantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + a.total_amount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>الإجمالي</td><td>' + rows.length + '</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>';
    } else if (type === 'by_customer') {
        const filtered = rows.filter(r => paymentType(r) === 'credit');
        const agg = aggregate(filtered, r => r.customer_name || r.customer_name_ar || 'بيع نقدي');
        if (!filtered.length) {
            bodyHtml = '<div class="report-no-data"><i class="fas fa-user-slash"></i>لا توجد مبيعات آجلة مطابقة</div>';
        } else {
            bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
                + '<thead><tr><th>العميل</th><th>عدد العمليات</th><th>الكمية</th><th>المبلغ الآجل</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
                + agg.map(a => '<tr><td>' + esc(a.key) + '</td><td>' + a.count + '</td><td>' + a.quantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + a.total_amount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>').join('')
                + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>الإجمالي</td><td>' + filtered.length + '</td><td>' + agg.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.quantity,0).toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + agg.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.total_amount,0).toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>';
        }
    } else if (type === 'daily') {
        const agg = aggregateDaily(rows);
        bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>التاريخ</th><th>عدد العمليات</th><th>الكمية (لتر)</th><th>المبلغ</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + agg.map(a => '<tr><td>' + esc(a.key) + '</td><td>' + a.count + '</td><td>' + a.quantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + a.total_amount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>الإجمالي</td><td>' + rows.length + '</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>';
    } else if (type === 'detailed') {
        bodyHtml = '<div class="report-table-wrap"><table class="report-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>التاريخ</th><th>الوقت</th><th>الوقود</th><th>اللترات</th><th>السعر</th><th>الإجمالي</th><th>الدفع</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + rows.slice(0, 500).map((r, i) => '<tr>'
                + '<td>' + (i+1) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(r.sale_date||'—') + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(r.sale_time||'—') + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(r.fuel_name_ar || r.fuel_name || r.fuel_type_id || '—') + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + numeric(r.quantity).toFixed(2) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + numeric(r.price_per_liter).toFixed(2) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + numeric(r.total_amount).toFixed(2) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(translateFieldValue('payment_method', r.payment_method)) + '</td>'
                + '</tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td colspan="4">الإجمالي</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>—</td><td>' + totalAmount.toLocaleString('ar',{maximumFractionDigits:2}) + '</td><td>—</td></tr></tfoot></table></div>';
        if (rows.length > 500) {
            bodyHtml += '<div style="padding:8px;text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.7rem;">يُعرض أول 500 سجل — استخدم التصدير لبقية ' + rows.length + ' سجل</div>';
        }
    }

    return headerHtml + summaryHtml + bodyHtml;
}

async function generateReport() {
    const results = $('reportResults');
    if (!results) return;
    const filters = readReportFilters();
    if (filters.from_date && filters.to_date && filters.from_date > filters.to_date) {
        showAdvancedNotification('تاريخ البداية يجب ألا يتجاوز تاريخ النهاية', 'warning', 'تنبيه');
        return;
    }
    if (!bridge) {
        showAdvancedNotification('Android Bridge غير متاح', 'error', 'خطأ');
        return;
    }

    results.style.display = 'block';
    results.innerHTML = '<div class="report-meta"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> جاري تحميل البيانات...</div>';
    setLoading(true);

    try {
        const fetchResult = await fetchAllForReport(filters);
        state.reportRows = fetchResult.rows || [];
        state.reportMeta = {
            from_date: filters.from_date,
            to_date: filters.to_date,
            total_count: fetchResult.total,
            generated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        const html = buildReportView(state.reportRows, state.reportMeta);
        results.innerHTML = html;
        showAdvancedNotification(
            'تم توليد التقرير — ' + state.reportRows.length + ' سجل',
            'success',
            '✅ التقرير جاهز'
        );
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[generateReport]', e);
        results.innerHTML = '<div class="report-no-data"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>فشل توليد التقرير: ' + esc(e.message || 'خطأ غير معروف') + '</div>';
        showAdvancedNotification(e.message || 'فشل توليد التقرير', 'error', 'فشل التقرير');
    } finally {
        setLoading(false);
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   Export (CSV) — Bottom sheet
   ============================================================ */
function openExportSheet() {
    if (!state.reportRows || !state.reportRows.length) {
        showAdvancedNotification('قم بتوليد التقرير أولاً قبل التصدير', 'warning', 'تنبيه');
        return;
    }
    if (window.StationExportRuntime) {
        const csv = buildCsvContent(state.reportRows);
        window.StationExportRuntime.openPreparedExport({
            filename: buildReportFilename(),
            mime: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8',
            blob: new Blob([csv], {type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),
            formats: ['csv', 'xlsx']
        });
        return;
    }
    const status = $('exportStatus');
    if (status) { status.className = 'export-status'; status.innerHTML = ''; }
    $('exportSheet').classList.add('show');
}

function closeExportSheet(event) {
    if (event && event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
    $('exportSheet').classList.remove('show');
}

function buildCsvContent(rows) {
    if (!rows.length) return '';
    const keys = ['sale_id','sale_date','sale_time','fuel_type_id','fuel_name','quantity','price_per_liter','total_amount','payment_method','customer_id','shift_id','pump_id','nozzle_id','notes'];
    const headers = keys.map(k => translateFieldLabel(k));
    const csvRows = [headers];
    rows.forEach(row => {
        csvRows.push(keys.map(k => {
            const v = row[k];
            if (v == null) return '';
            return String(v).replace(/"/g, '""');
        }));
    });
    const BOM = '\uFEFF';
    return BOM + csvRows.map(r => r.map(v => '"' + v + '"').join(',')).join('\n');
}

function buildReportFilename() {
    const meta = state.reportMeta || {};
    const typeLabel = REPORT_TYPE_LABELS[state.reportType] || 'تقرير';
    const from = meta.from_date || 'غير_محدد';
    const to = meta.to_date || 'غير_محدد';
    let name = 'تقرير_مبيعات_الوقود_' + typeLabel + '_' + from + '_' + to;
    return name.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\n\r\t]/g, '_').replace(/\s+/g, '_').substring(0, 100);
}

async function confirmExport(mode) {
    const status = $('exportStatus');
    if (!status) return;
    if (!state.reportRows || !state.reportRows.length) {
        status.className = 'export-status error show';
        status.textContent = 'لا توجد بيانات للتصدير. قم بتوليد التقرير أولاً.';
        return;
    }
    const filename = buildReportFilename();

    if (mode === 'bridge') {
        status.className = 'export-status show';
        status.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> جاري التصدير عبر النظام...';
        try {
            if (!bridge || typeof bridge.exportOperationalCsv !== 'function') {
                throw new Error('طريقة التصدير عبر النظام غير متاحة في هذا الإصدار');
            }
            const filters = readReportFilters();
            const params = {
                limit: 1000,
                offset: 0
            };
            if (filters.from_date) params.from_date = filters.from_date;
            if (filters.to_date) params.to_date = filters.to_date;

            const done = new Promise((resolve) => {
                window.onOperationalExportResult = function(result) {
                    resolve(result || {});
                };
                setTimeout(() => resolve({timeout: true}), 30000);
            });

            try {
                const raw = bridge.exportOperationalCsv('fuel_sales', JSON.stringify(params));
                const ack = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
                if (ack && ack.success === false) throw new Error(ack.error || ack.message || 'رفض الجسر بدء التصدير');
            } catch (e) {
                throw new Error(e.message || 'تعذر بدء التصدير');
            }

            const result = await done;
            if (result.timeout) {
                status.className = 'export-status error show';
                status.textContent = 'انتهت مهلة التصدير. تحقق من مجلد التطبيق.';
                return;
            }
            if (result.success) {
                status.className = 'export-status show';
                status.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> تم التصدير بنجاح'
                    + '<span class="export-path">' + esc(result.path || '') + '</span>'
                    + '<div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted);">يمكنك فتح الملف عبر مدير الملفات في المسار أعلاه</div>';
            } else {
                status.className = 'export-status error show';
                status.textContent = result.error || 'فشل التصدير';
            }
        } catch (e) {
            status.className = 'export-status error show';
            status.textContent = e.message || 'فشل التصدير عبر النظام';
        }
    } else if (mode === 'browser') {
        status.className = 'export-status show';
        status.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> جاري تجهيز الملف للتنزيل...';
        try {
            const csv = buildCsvContent(state.reportRows);
            if (!csv) throw new Error('لا توجد بيانات');
            const blob = new Blob([csv], {type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = filename + '.csv';
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.body.removeChild(a);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            }, 500);
            status.className = 'export-status show';
            status.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> تم تجهيز الملف للتنزيل. ابحث عنه في مجلد التنزيلات.';
        } catch (e) {
            status.className = 'export-status error show';
            status.textContent = e.message || 'فشل التنزيل';
        }
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   Print
   ============================================================ */
function buildPrintHtml() {
    const rows = state.reportRows || [];
    const meta = state.reportMeta || {};
    const type = state.reportType || 'summary';
    const typeLabel = REPORT_TYPE_LABELS[type] || 'تقرير';

    if (!rows.length) {
        return '<div class="print-doc-header"><h2>لا توجد بيانات</h2><div class="print-meta">قم بتوليد التقرير أولاً</div></div>';
    }

    const totalQuantity = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.quantity), 0);
    const totalAmount = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.total_amount), 0);
    const totalReturned = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.returned_quantity), 0);
    const totalDamaged = rows.reduce((s,r) => s + numeric(r.damaged_quantity), 0);

    let tableHtml = '';
    if (type === 'detailed') {
        tableHtml = '<table class="print-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>التاريخ</th><th>الوقت</th><th>الوقود</th><th>اللترات</th><th>السعر</th><th>الإجمالي</th><th>الدفع</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + rows.slice(0, 200).map((r, i) => '<tr>'
                + '<td>' + (i+1) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(r.sale_date||'—') + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(r.sale_time||'—') + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(r.fuel_name_ar || r.fuel_name || r.fuel_type_id || '—') + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + numeric(r.quantity).toFixed(2) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + numeric(r.price_per_liter).toFixed(2) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + numeric(r.total_amount).toFixed(2) + '</td>'
                + '<td>' + esc(translateFieldValue('payment_method', r.payment_method)) + '</td>'
                + '</tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td colspan="4">الإجمالي</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>—</td><td>' + totalAmount.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>—</td></tr></tfoot></table>';
    } else if (type === 'by_fuel_type' || type === 'by_pump' || type === 'by_payment' || type === 'by_shift' || type === 'by_customer' || type === 'daily') {
        let keyFn;
        let header = '';
        if (type === 'by_fuel_type') {
            keyFn = r => r.fuel_name_ar || r.fuel_name || ('وقود ' + (r.fuel_type_id || ''));
            header = 'نوع الوقود';
        } else if (type === 'by_pump') {
            keyFn = r => r.pump_name_ar || r.pump_name || r.pump_code || ('مضخة ' + (r.pump_id || ''));
            header = 'المضخة';
        } else if (type === 'by_payment') {
            keyFn = r => translateFieldValue('payment_method', r.payment_method);
            header = 'طريقة الدفع';
        } else if (type === 'by_shift') {
            keyFn = r => r.shift_code || r.shift_name || ('وردية #' + (r.shift_id || ''));
            header = 'الوردية';
        } else if (type === 'by_customer') {
            keyFn = r => r.customer_name || r.customer_name_ar || 'بيع نقدي';
            header = 'العميل';
        } else {
            keyFn = r => r.sale_date || 'بدون تاريخ';
            header = 'التاريخ';
        }
        const agg = type === 'daily' ? aggregateDaily(rows) : aggregate(rows, keyFn);
        tableHtml = '<table class="print-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>' + header + '</th><th>عدد العمليات</th><th>الكمية (لتر)</th><th>المبلغ</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + agg.map(a => '<tr><td>' + esc(a.key) + '</td><td>' + a.count + '</td><td>' + a.quantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + a.total_amount.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>').join('')
            + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td>الإجمالي</td><td>' + rows.length + '</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td><td>' + totalAmount.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr></tfoot></table>';
    } else {
        tableHtml = '<table class="print-table">'
            + '<thead><tr><th>البيان</th><th>القيمة</th></tr></thead><tbody>'
            + '<tr><td>عدد السجلات</td><td>' + rows.length + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي الكمية (لتر)</td><td>' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي المبالغ</td><td>' + totalAmount.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي المرتجع</td><td>' + totalReturned.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>'
            + '<tr><td>إجمالي التالف</td><td>' + totalDamaged.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>'
            + '</tbody></table>';
    }

    return '<div class="print-doc-header">'
        + '<h2>تقرير مبيعات الوقود — ' + esc(typeLabel) + '</h2>'
        + '<div class="print-meta">الفترة: من ' + esc(meta.from_date || '—') + ' إلى ' + esc(meta.to_date || '—') + '</div>'
        + '<div class="print-meta">تاريخ الإصدار: ' + esc(new Date().toLocaleString('ar')) + '</div>'
        + '</div>'
        + '<div class="print-summary">'
        + '<div class="print-summary-card"><div class="label">عدد السجلات</div><div class="value">' + rows.length + '</div></div>'
        + '<div class="print-summary-card"><div class="label">إجمالي اللترات</div><div class="value">' + totalQuantity.toFixed(2) + '</div></div>'
        + '<div class="print-summary-card"><div class="label">إجمالي المبالغ</div><div class="value">' + totalAmount.toFixed(2) + '</div></div>'
        + '<div class="print-summary-card"><div class="label">مرتجع + تالف</div><div class="value">' + (totalReturned + totalDamaged).toFixed(2) + '</div></div>'
        + '</div>'
        + tableHtml
        + '<div class="print-footer">تقرير مُولَّد من نظام إدارة محطة الوقود — البيانات مستخرجة من SQLite</div>';
}

async function printReport() {
    if (!state.reportRows || !state.reportRows.length) {
        showAdvancedNotification('قم بتوليد التقرير أولاً قبل الطباعة', 'warning', 'تنبيه');
        return;
    }
    const printArea = $('printArea');
    if (!printArea) {
        showAdvancedNotification('منطقة الطباعة غير متاحة', 'error', 'خطأ');
        return;
    }
    printArea.innerHTML = buildPrintHtml();
    const filename = buildReportFilename();

    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));

    try {
        if (window.StationExportRuntime) {
            window.StationExportRuntime.openPrint({filename: filename});
            return;
        }
        if (bridge && typeof bridge.printCurrentPageWithTitle === 'function') {
            const raw = bridge.printCurrentPageWithTitle(filename);
            const ack = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
            if (ack && ack.success === false) {
                throw new Error(ack.error || 'فشل فتح نافذة الطباعة');
            }
            showAdvancedNotification(
                'تم فتح معاينة الطباعة. يمكنك اختيار "حفظ كـ PDF" — سيُحفظ باسم: ' + filename,
                'success',
                'الطباعة جاهزة'
            );
        } else if (typeof window.print === 'function') {
            window.print();
        } else {
            throw new Error('لا توجد طريقة طباعة متاحة');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        showAdvancedNotification(e.message || 'فشل الطباعة', 'error', 'خطأ');
        try { window.print(); } catch (_) {}
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   Fuel Adjustment
   ============================================================ */
let fuelAdjustmentRow = null;

function resetFuelAdjustmentForm(options) {
    const opts = options || {};
    if (opts.keepDropdown !== true) {
        const sel = $('fuelAdjustmentSaleSelect');
        if (sel) sel.value = '';
    }
    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewFuel').value = '';
    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewDate').value = '';
    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewCustomer').value = '';
    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewQty').value = '';
    $('fuelAdjustmentAvailable').value = '';
    $('fuelAdjustmentQty').value = '';
    $('fuelAdjustmentReason').value = '';
    const typeEl = $('fuelAdjustmentType');
    if (typeEl) typeEl.value = 'return';
    fuelAdjustmentRow = null;
}

function fillFuelAdjustmentFromRow(row) {
    if (!row) return;
    fuelAdjustmentRow = row;
    const saleId = Number(row.sale_id || row.id || 0);
    const fuelLabel = translateFieldValue('fuel_type_id', row.fuel_name_ar || row.fuel_name || row.fuel_type_name || row.fuel_type_id);
    const saleDate = String(row.sale_date || '').trim() || '—';
    const saleTime = String(row.sale_time || '').trim();
    const saleDateFull = saleTime ? saleDate + ' — ' + saleTime : saleDate;
    const customer = String(row.customer_name || row.customer_name_ar || row.customer_display_name || '').trim() || 'بيع نقدي';
    const originalQty = numeric(row.original_quantity ?? row.quantity);
    const alreadyReturned = numeric(row.returned_quantity);
    const alreadyDamaged = numeric(row.damaged_quantity);
    const available = Math.max(0, originalQty - alreadyReturned - alreadyDamaged);

    const sel = $('fuelAdjustmentSaleSelect');
    if (sel && !sel.value && saleId) sel.value = String(saleId);

    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewFuel').value = fuelLabel;
    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewDate').value = saleDateFull;
    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewCustomer').value = customer;
    $('fuelAdjustmentPreviewQty').value = originalQty.toFixed(2) + ' لتر';
    $('fuelAdjustmentAvailable').value = available.toFixed(2);
    $('fuelAdjustmentQty').value = available > 0 ? available.toFixed(2) : '';
    $('fuelAdjustmentQty').max = String(available);
    $('fuelAdjustmentReason').value = '';
}

async function populateFuelAdjustmentSaleSelect() {
    const sel = $('fuelAdjustmentSaleSelect');
    if (!sel) return;
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">جارٍ تحميل القائمة...</option>';
    try {
        const result = await invoke('getFuelSalesPage', [JSON.stringify({limit: 500, offset: 0})]);
        const rows = rowsFrom(result);
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
            const idA = Number(a.sale_id || a.id || 0);
            const idB = Number(b.sale_id || b.id || 0);
            return idB - idA;
        });
        state.fuelAdjustmentCache = rows;
        if (!rows.length) {
            sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">لا توجد مبيعات وقود</option>';
            return;
        }
        const options = rows.map(r => {
            const saleId = Number(r.sale_id || r.id || 0);
            const date = String(r.sale_date || '').trim();
            const time = String(r.sale_time || '').trim();
            const fuel = r.fuel_name_ar || r.fuel_name || ('وقود #' + (r.fuel_type_id || ''));
            const qty = numeric(r.original_quantity ?? r.quantity).toFixed(2);
            const dt = [date, time].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
            return '<option value="' + saleId + '">#' + saleId + ' — ' + esc(dt) + ' — ' + esc(fuel) + ' — ' + qty + ' لتر</option>';
        }).join('');
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— اختر رقم البيع —</option>' + options;
    } catch (e) {
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">تعذر تحميل القائمة</option>';
        showAdvancedNotification('تعذر تحميل قائمة مبيعات الوقود: ' + (e.message||''), 'error', 'خطأ');
    }
}

async function openFuelAdjustment(row) {
    resetFuelAdjustmentForm({keepDropdown: false});
    if (row) {
        fillFuelAdjustmentFromRow(row);
        openModal(null, 'fuelAdjustmentModal');
        populateFuelAdjustmentSaleSelect().then(() => {
            const sel = $('fuelAdjustmentSaleSelect');
            const saleId = Number(row.sale_id || row.id || 0);
            if (sel && saleId) {
                let found = false;
                for (let i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
                    if (Number(sel.options[i].value) === saleId) { found = true; break; }
                }
                if (!found) {
                    const opt = document.createElement('option');
                    opt.value = String(saleId);
                    opt.textContent = '#' + saleId + ' — ' + (row.sale_date || '') + ' — ' + (row.fuel_name_ar || row.fuel_type_id || '');
                    sel.appendChild(opt);
                }
                sel.value = String(saleId);
            }
        });
    } else {
        openModal(null, 'fuelAdjustmentModal');
        await populateFuelAdjustmentSaleSelect();
    }
}

async function saveFuelAdjustment() {
    const saleIdFromRow = fuelAdjustmentRow ? Number(fuelAdjustmentRow.sale_id || fuelAdjustmentRow.id || 0) : 0;
    const saleIdFromSelect = Number($('fuelAdjustmentSaleSelect')?.value || 0);
    const saleId = saleIdFromRow || saleIdFromSelect;
    if (!saleId) {
        showAdvancedNotification('يرجى اختيار رقم البيع أولاً', 'warning', 'تنبيه');
        return;
    }
    if (saleIdFromSelect && saleIdFromSelect !== saleIdFromRow) {
        const cached = state.fuelAdjustmentCache.find(r => Number(r.sale_id || r.id) === saleIdFromSelect);
        if (cached) fuelAdjustmentRow = cached;
    }
    const qty = Number($('fuelAdjustmentQty').value);
    const available = Number($('fuelAdjustmentAvailable').value || 0);
    const reason = ($('fuelAdjustmentReason').value || '').trim();
    if (!Number.isFinite(qty) || qty <= 0) {
        showAdvancedNotification('الكمية يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر', 'warning', 'تنبيه');
        return;
    }
    if (!(available > 0) || qty > available + 1e-9) {
        showAdvancedNotification('الكمية تتجاوز المتاح (' + available.toFixed(2) + ' لتر) أو لا توجد كمية متبقية', 'warning', 'تنبيه');
        return;
    }
    if (!reason) {
        showAdvancedNotification('يرجى إدخال سبب الإرجاع / التلف', 'warning', 'تنبيه');
        return;
    }
    const confirmBtn = $('fuelAdjustmentConfirmBtn');
    if (confirmBtn) confirmBtn.disabled = true;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
        const payload = {
            sale_id: saleId,
            fuel_sale_id: Number((fuelAdjustmentRow && fuelAdjustmentRow.fuel_sale_id) || 0),
            adjustment_type: $('fuelAdjustmentType').value || 'return',
            quantity: qty,
            reason: reason,
            idempotency_key: newIdempotencyKey()
        };
        const result = parse(await invoke('processFuelSaleAdjustment', [JSON.stringify(payload)]));
        const message = result.message || (result.data && result.data.message) || 'تم توثيق العملية بنجاح';
        showAdvancedNotification(message, 'success', '✅ تم التوثيق');
        closeModal(null, 'fuelAdjustmentModal');
        resetFuelAdjustmentForm();
        await reloadData();
    } catch (e) {
        showAdvancedNotification(e.message || 'تعذر توثيق العملية', 'error', '❌ فشل');
    } finally {
        if (confirmBtn) confirmBtn.disabled = false;
        setLoading(false);
    }
}

function setupFuelAdjustmentEvents() {
    const sel = $('fuelAdjustmentSaleSelect');
    if (sel) {
        sel.addEventListener('change', function() {
            const saleId = Number(this.value || 0);
            if (!saleId) { resetFuelAdjustmentForm({keepDropdown: true}); return; }
            let row = state.fuelAdjustmentCache.find(r => Number(r.sale_id || r.id) === saleId);
            if (!row) row = {sale_id: saleId};
            fillFuelAdjustmentFromRow(row);
        });
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   Theme
   ============================================================ */
function goHome() { window.location.href = '../main.html'; }

function applyTheme() {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'light';
    if (saved === 'dark') document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark';
    else delete document.documentElement.dataset.theme;
    const icon = $('themeIcon');
    if (icon) icon.textContent = saved === 'dark' ? '🌞' : '🌙';
}

function toggleTheme() {
    const dark = document.documentElement.dataset.theme === 'dark';
    if (dark) delete document.documentElement.dataset.theme;
    else document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark';
    localStorage.setItem('theme', dark ? 'light' : 'dark');
    const icon = $('themeIcon');
    if (icon) icon.textContent = dark ? '🌙' : '🌞';
}

/* ============================================================
   INIT
   ============================================================ */
$('searchInput').addEventListener('input', () => CFG.listMethod === 'getFuelSalesPage' ? reloadData() : applyFilter());
$('themeToggle').addEventListener('click', toggleTheme);
$('saveBtn').addEventListener('click', saveForm);
$('deliveryBtn').addEventListener('click', () => openDelivery($('deliveryBtn').dataset.saleId));

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if ($('formModal')?.classList.contains('show')) state.formOpenSequence++;
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('show'));
        const es = $('exportSheet');
        if (es) es.classList.remove('show');
        document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
        setTimeout(updateTopBarHeight, 100);
    }

/** Reads an ASCII Base64 String as bytes without allocating a second full-size byte array. */
private class AsciiStringInputStream(private val value: String) : InputStream() {
    private var position = 0

    override fun read(): Int {
        if (position >= value.length) return -1
        val next = value[position++].code
        if (next > 0x7f) throw IOException("Base64 export payload must be ASCII")
        return next
    }

    override fun read(buffer: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int {
        if (offset < 0 || length < 0 || length > buffer.size - offset) {
            throw IndexOutOfBoundsException("Invalid buffer range")
        }
        if (length == 0) return 0
        if (position >= value.length) return -1
        val count = minOf(length, value.length - position)
        for (index in 0 until count) {
            val next = value[position++].code
            if (next > 0x7f) throw IOException("Base64 export payload must be ASCII")
            buffer[offset + index] = next.toByte()
        }
        return count
    }
}

        // ============================
        object DebugLogger {
            private const val TAG = "DebugLogger"
            private var webViewRef: WeakReference<WebView>? = null
            @Volatile private var developerModeEnabled = BuildConfig.DEBUG
            @Volatile private var isVConsoleReady = BuildConfig.DEBUG

            fun attachWebView(webView: WebView?) {
                webViewRef = WeakReference(webView)
                isVConsoleReady = developerModeEnabled
                info("DebugLogger", "Attached to WebView")
            }

            fun setDeveloperModeEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
                developerModeEnabled = enabled
                isVConsoleReady = developerModeEnabled
                info("DebugLogger", "Developer diagnostics ${if (developerModeEnabled) "enabled" else "disabled"}")
            }

            fun isDeveloperModeEnabled(): Boolean = developerModeEnabled

            fun detachWebView() {
                webViewRef?.clear()
                webViewRef = null
                isVConsoleReady = false
            }

            fun info(tag: String, message: String) {
                val full = "[$tag] $message"
                Log.i(TAG, full)
                sendToVConsole("INFO", full)
            }

            fun warn(tag: String, message: String) {
                val full = "[$tag] $message"
                Log.w(TAG, full)
                sendToVConsole("WARN", full)
            }

            fun error(tag: String, message: String, throwable: Throwable? = null) {
                val full = if (throwable != null) {
                    "$message\n${throwable.stackTraceToString()}"
                } else {
                    message
                }
                Log.e(TAG, "[$tag] $full")
                sendToVConsole("ERROR", "[$tag] $full")
            }

            private fun sendToVConsole(level: String, message: String) {
                if (!isVConsoleReady) return
                val wv = webViewRef?.get() ?: return
                val escaped = message.replace("\\", "\\\\")
                    .replace("\"", "\\\"")
                    .replace("\n", "\n")
                val js = """
                    (function() {
                        if (typeof vConsole !== 'undefined' && vConsole) {
                            var msg = "$escaped";
                            var prefix = "[Kotlin] ";
                            switch("$level") {
                                case "INFO": vConsole.log(prefix + msg); break;
                                case "WARN": vConsole.warn(prefix + msg); break;
                                case "ERROR": vConsole.error(prefix + msg); break;
                                default: vConsole.log(prefix + msg);
                            }
                        }
                    })();
                """.trimIndent()
                wv.post {
                    try {
                        wv.evaluateJavascript(js, null)
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        // Ignore
                    }
                }
            }

            fun logException(tag: String, throwable: Throwable) {
                error(tag, throwable.message ?: "Exception occurred", throwable)
            }

            fun logEvent(event: String, details: String = "") {
                info("EVENT", "$event | $details")
            }
        }

        // ============================
        // معالج الأخطاء العام (Global Exception Handler)
        // ============================
        private val defaultExceptionHandler = Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler()

        fun installGlobalExceptionHandler() {
            Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler { thread, throwable ->
                DebugLogger.logException("GlobalException", throwable)
                defaultExceptionHandler?.uncaughtException(thread, throwable)
            }
        }
    }

    private val securityIdleRunnable = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            if (isDestroyed.get()) return
            if (startupDatabaseReady && hasWindowFocus() && !securityPromptActive &&
                !currentAuthToken.isNullOrBlank()
            ) {
                val timeoutMinutes = securitySettingValue("autoLogoutMinutes").toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(0, 1440) ?: 0
                if (timeoutMinutes > 0 &&
                    android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - lastSecurityInteractionElapsed >= timeoutMinutes * 60_000L
                ) {
                    forceSecurityLogout("security_auto_logout", allowRememberMeBiometric = true)
                }
            }
            if (!isDestroyed.get()) handler.postDelayed(this, 5_000L)
        }
