        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
            if (!container) return;
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast ${type}`;
            const text = document.createElement('span');
            text.textContent = String(message || '');
            toast.appendChild(text);
            container.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (toast.parentNode) {
                    toast.classList.add('dismiss');
                    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
                }
            }, 4000);
        }

        function showLoading(show) {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('loadingOverlay');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.toggle('active', show);
        }

        // ================================================================
        // الساعة والتاريخ
        // ================================================================
        function updateDateTime() {
            if (isSleeping) return false;
            const now = new Date();
            const businessDayChanged = dashboardBusinessDayWatcher(now);
            const dateEl = document.getElementById('dateText');
            const timeEl = document.getElementById('timeText');
            if (dateEl) {
                try {
                    dateEl.textContent = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-EG', {
                        weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric',
                        timeZone: window.DEFAULT_BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE || 'Asia/Aden'
                    }).format(now);
                } catch (e) {
                    dateEl.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString('ar-EG');
                }
            }
            if (timeEl) {
                try {
                    timeEl.textContent = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
                        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: false,
                        timeZone: window.DEFAULT_BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE || 'Asia/Aden'
                    }).format(now);
                } catch (e) {
                    timeEl.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB');
                }
            }
            return businessDayChanged;
        }

        // ================================================================
        // تحميل إعدادات العرض وتطبيقها
        // ================================================================
        async function waitForAndroidBridge(maxAttempts = 10) {
            for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++) {
                if (useAndroidInterface && androidInterface) return true;
                initAndroidBridge();
                if (useAndroidInterface && androidInterface) return true;
                await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
            }
            return useAndroidInterface && !!androidInterface;
        }

        async function loadDisplaySettings(force = false) {
            const now = Date.now();
            if (!force && displaySettingsLoadedAt && now - displaySettingsLoadedAt < 30000) return;
            if (displaySettingsLoadPromise) return displaySettingsLoadPromise;
            displaySettingsLoadPromise = (async function () {
            try {
                if (!await waitForAndroidBridge()) {
                    throw new Error('AndroidInterface غير متاح بعد عدة محاولات');
                }
                const response = await apiCall('getAllSystemSettingsMap');
                if (!response || response.success === false) {
                    throw new Error((response && response.error) || 'تعذر قراءة إعدادات العرض');
                }
                const values = response.data && typeof response.data === 'object' ? response.data : response;
                displaySettings = { ...DEFAULT_DISPLAY_SETTINGS };
                for (const key of Object.keys(DEFAULT_DISPLAY_SETTINGS)) {
                    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values, key)) {
                        displaySettings[key] = String(values[key] ?? '');
                    }
                }
                displaySettingsLoadedAt = Date.now();
            } catch (error) {
                console.warn('تعذر تحميل إعدادات العرض المحفوظة؛ ستستخدم القيم الآمنة الافتراضية:', error);
                displaySettings = { ...DEFAULT_DISPLAY_SETTINGS };
            }

            applySleepTextStyle();
            applyFontScale();
            applyReduceMotion();
            applyScheduledTheme();
            applySleepOverlayImage();

            // تحديث ساعة السكون
            syncSleepClock();
            })();
            try {
                await displaySettingsLoadPromise;
            } finally {
                displaySettingsLoadPromise = null;
            }
        }

        function applySleepTextStyle() {
            const sleepText = document.getElementById('sleepText');
            if (!sleepText) return;

            const fs = Math.max(12, Math.min(72, parseInt(displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_FONT_SIZE, 10) || 30));
            const color = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_TEXT_COLOR || '')
                ? displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_TEXT_COLOR
                : '#D4A86A';

            sleepText.textContent = displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_TEXT ?? '';
            sleepText.style.fontSize = fs + 'px';
            sleepText.style.color = color;
            sleepText.style.textShadow = '0 0 20px ' + color + ', 0 0 40px ' + color + ', 0 0 80px ' + color + '80';
        }

        function applyFontScale() {
            const scale = Math.max(80, Math.min(150, parseInt(displaySettings.DISPLAY_FONT_SCALE, 10) || 100));
            document.documentElement.style.fontSize = scale + '%';
        }

        function applyReduceMotion() {
            if (String(displaySettings.DISPLAY_REDUCE_MOTION) === '1') {
                document.body.classList.add('reduce-motion');
            } else {
                document.body.classList.remove('reduce-motion');
            }
        }

        function applySleepOverlayImage() {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sleepOverlay');
            if (!overlay) return;

            overlay.style.backgroundImage = '';
            const imagePath = String(displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_IMAGE || '').trim();
            if (!imagePath) return;

            const opacity = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, parseInt(displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_OVERLAY_OPACITY, 10) || 45));
            const alpha = (opacity / 100).toFixed(2);

            const applyImage = (dataUrl) => {
                if (typeof dataUrl === 'string' && /^data:image\//i.test(dataUrl)) {
                    overlay.style.backgroundImage = 'linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,' + alpha + '),rgba(0,0,0,' + alpha + ')),url("' + dataUrl.replace(/["\\]/g, '') + '")';
                    overlay.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
                    overlay.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
                }
            };

            if (/^data:image\//i.test(imagePath)) {
                applyImage(imagePath);
                return;
            }

            if (window.AndroidInterface && typeof window.AndroidInterface.getImageDataUrl === 'function') {
                try {
                    const raw = window.AndroidInterface.getImageDataUrl(imagePath);
                    const result = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
                    const image = result && result.data ? result.data : result;
                    const dataUrl = typeof image === 'string' ? image : (image && (image.dataUrl || image.data_url || image.base64));
                    applyImage(dataUrl);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('تعذر تحميل صورة شاشة التوقف:', e);
                }
            }
        }

        // ================================================================
        // الساعة الكبيرة في شاشة التوقف
        // ================================================================
        let sleepClockInterval = null;

        function syncSleepClock() {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sleepOverlay');
            if (!overlay) return;

            const wantClock = String(displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_CLOCK) === '1';
            let clockEl = document.getElementById('sleepClock');

            if (wantClock) {
                if (!clockEl) {
                    clockEl = document.createElement('div');
                    clockEl.id = 'sleepClock';
                    clockEl.className = 'sleep-clock';
                    overlay.appendChild(clockEl);
                }
                updateSleepClockText();
                if (!sleepClockInterval) {
                    sleepClockInterval = setInterval(updateSleepClockText, 1000);
                }
            } else if (clockEl) {
                if (sleepClockInterval) {
                    clearInterval(sleepClockInterval);
                    sleepClockInterval = null;
                }
                clockEl.remove();
            }
        }

        function updateSleepClockText() {
            const clockEl = document.getElementById('sleepClock');
            if (!clockEl) return;
            try {
                clockEl.textContent = window.businessDayTime(new Date());
            } catch (_) {
                // Do not silently display the handset's unrelated timezone.
                clockEl.textContent = '--:--:--';
            }
        }

        // ================================================================
        // جدولة الوضع الليلي
        // ================================================================
        function applyScheduledTheme() {
            if (String(displaySettings.DISPLAY_DARK_MODE_SCHEDULE_ENABLED) !== '1') return;
            const now = new Date();
            let cur;
            try {
                const [stationHour, stationMinute] = window.businessDayTime(now).split(':').map(Number);
                cur = stationHour * 60 + stationMinute;
            } catch (_) {
                return;
            }
            const [fh, fm] = (displaySettings.DISPLAY_DARK_MODE_FROM || '20:00').split(':').map(Number);
            const [th, tm] = (displaySettings.DISPLAY_DARK_MODE_TO || '07:00').split(':').map(Number);
            const from = (fh || 0) * 60 + (fm || 0);
            const to = (th || 0) * 60 + (tm || 0);
            const inRange = from < to ? (cur >= from && cur < to) : (cur >= from || cur < to);
            const next = inRange ? 'dark' : 'light';
            const current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
            if (current !== next && current !== null && current !== '') {
                document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
                updateThemeButton(next === 'dark');
            }
        }
        setInterval(applyScheduledTheme, 60000);

        // ================================================================
        // Sleep Mode
        // ================================================================
        function isSleepScreenEnabled() {
            const v = parseInt(displaySettings.DISPLAY_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 10);
            return Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0;
        }
        function isLockScreenEnabled() {
            return String(displaySettings.DISPLAY_LOCK_ON_IDLE) === '1';
        }
        function effectiveIdleMode() {
            if (isSleepScreenEnabled()) return 'sleep';
            if (isLockScreenEnabled()) return 'lock';
            return 'none';
        }
        function resetInactivityTimer() {
            if (inactivityTimer) { clearTimeout(inactivityTimer); inactivityTimer = null; }
            if (isSleeping || effectiveIdleMode() !== 'sleep') return;
            const seconds = Number.parseInt(displaySettings.DISPLAY_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 10);
            if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds <= 0) return;
            inactivityTimer = setTimeout(enterSleepMode, Math.max(5, seconds) * 1000);
        }

        function getSleepSpeedInterval() {
            const map = { slow: 6000, normal: 2200, fast: 1500 };
            return map[displaySettings.DISPLAY_SLEEP_SPEED] || 2200;
        }

        function enterSleepMode() {
            if (isSleeping) return;
            isSleeping = true;
            clearSessionTimers();
            hideSessionWarning();

            document.body.classList.add('sleep-active');

            if (clockInterval) { clearInterval(clockInterval); clockInterval = null; }
            if (inactivityTimer) { clearTimeout(inactivityTimer); inactivityTimer = null; }

            hideAllBubbles();

            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            if (sidebar && sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
                sidebar.classList.remove('open');
                document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.remove('active');
                document.getElementById('sideTab').classList.remove('hidden');
                const pathEl = document.getElementById('sPath');
                if (pathEl) {
                    pathEl.setAttribute('d', createElasticD(SIDEBAR_CLOSED, 0));
                    currentLeadX = SIDEBAR_CLOSED;
                }
            }

            const overlay = document.getElementById('sleepOverlay');
            overlay.classList.add('active');

            const sleepText = document.getElementById('sleepText');
            if (sleepText) {
                sleepText.style.transition = 'none';
                sleepText.style.left = '50%';
                sleepText.style.top = '50%';
                sleepText.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%)';
            }

            syncSleepClock();

            setTimeout(() => {
                if (sleepText) {
                    sleepText.style.transition = 'left ' + (getSleepSpeedInterval() / 1000 * 0.73).toFixed(2) + 's cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95), top ' + (getSleepSpeedInterval() / 1000 * 0.73).toFixed(2) + 's cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95)';
                }
                moveSleepText();
                if (sleepMoveInterval) clearInterval(sleepMoveInterval);
                sleepMoveInterval = setInterval(moveSleepText, getSleepSpeedInterval());
            }, 400);
        }

        function moveSleepText() {
            const text = document.getElementById('sleepText');
            if (!text) return;

            const padding = 16;
            const w = window.innerWidth;
            const h = window.innerHeight;

            text.style.left = '0px';
            text.style.top = '0px';
            text.style.transform = 'none';
            const tw = text.offsetWidth || 200;
            const th = text.offsetHeight || 50;

            const maxX = Math.max(padding, w - tw - padding);
            const maxY = Math.max(padding, h - th - padding);

            const phase = (Date.now() / 1000) % 1;
            const x = padding + phase * Math.max(0, maxX - padding);
            const y = padding + (1 - phase) * Math.max(0, maxY - padding);

            text.style.left = x + 'px';
            text.style.top = y + 'px';
            text.style.transform = 'none';
        }

        function exitSleepMode(event) {
            if (!isSleeping) return;
            if (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
            }
            isSleeping = false;

            const overlay = document.getElementById('sleepOverlay');
            overlay.classList.remove('active');

            if (sleepMoveInterval) {
                clearInterval(sleepMoveInterval);
                sleepMoveInterval = null;
            }

            document.body.classList.remove('sleep-active');

            let businessDayChanged = false;
            if (!clockInterval) {
                clockInterval = setInterval(updateDateTime, 1000);
                businessDayChanged = updateDateTime();
            }

            if (!businessDayChanged) loadDashboard(true);

            handleUserActivity();
        }

        function initSleepMode() {
            const events = ['mousemove', 'mousedown', 'touchstart', 'touchmove', 'keydown', 'scroll', 'click', 'wheel'];
            events.forEach(evt => {
                document.addEventListener(evt, function(event) {
                    // Android emits touchstart before click. Ignore warning
                    // overlay interactions so the overlay is not dismissed
                    // before its action button's click handler can run.
                    const target = event && event.target;
                    if (target && typeof target.closest === 'function'
                        && target.closest('#sessionWarningOverlay')) return;
                    handleUserActivity();
                }, { passive: true });
            });
            handleUserActivity();
        }

        // ================================================================
        // Session Timeout (Windows-like)
        // ================================================================
        function clearSessionTimers() {
            if (sessionTimeoutTimer) { clearTimeout(sessionTimeoutTimer); sessionTimeoutTimer = null; }
            if (sessionWarningTimer) { clearTimeout(sessionWarningTimer); sessionWarningTimer = null; }
            if (sessionWarningCountdownTimer) { clearInterval(sessionWarningCountdownTimer); sessionWarningCountdownTimer = null; }
        }

        function handleUserActivity() {
            if (isSleeping) return;
            hideSessionWarning();
            resetInactivityTimer();
            scheduleSessionTimeout();
        }

        function scheduleSessionTimeout() {
            clearSessionTimers();
            hideSessionWarning();

            if (effectiveIdleMode() !== 'lock') return;
            const totalSeconds = parseInt(displaySettings.DISPLAY_SESSION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 10);
            if (!Number.isFinite(totalSeconds) || totalSeconds <= 0) return;

            const warningSeconds = Math.max(5, Math.min(totalSeconds - 1,
                parseInt(displaySettings.DISPLAY_SESSION_WARNING_SECONDS, 10) || 30));
            const warningAt = Math.max(1, totalSeconds - warningSeconds);

            sessionWarningTimer = setTimeout(() => showSessionWarning(warningSeconds), warningAt * 1000);
            sessionTimeoutTimer = setTimeout(() => performSessionLock('idle_timeout'), totalSeconds * 1000);
        }

        function showSessionWarning(warningSeconds) {
            if (sessionWarningVisible) return;

            // If sleeping, wake up first so user sees warning
            if (isSleeping) {
                isSleeping = false;
                const overlay = document.getElementById('sleepOverlay');
                if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');
                if (sleepMoveInterval) { clearInterval(sleepMoveInterval); sleepMoveInterval = null; }
                document.body.classList.remove('sleep-active');
                if (!clockInterval) { clockInterval = setInterval(updateDateTime, 1000); }

                console.warn('[Display] Session warning fired while sleeping — mutual exclusion triggered cleanup.');
            }

            sessionWarningVisible = true;
            sessionWarningRemaining = warningSeconds;

            let overlay = document.getElementById('sessionWarningOverlay');
            if (!overlay) {
                overlay = document.createElement('div');
                overlay.id = 'sessionWarningOverlay';
                overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;';
                overlay.innerHTML =
                    '<div style="background:#FFFFFF;color:#1E1C1A;border-radius:20px;padding:26px;max-width:420px;width:100%;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.45);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);font-family:\'Tajawal\',\'Inter\',sans-serif;">' +
                        '<div style="font-size:34px;margin-bottom:8px;">🔒</div>' +
                        '<h3 style="margin:0 0 10px;font-size:18px;font-weight:800;">سيتم قفل الشاشة قريباً</h3>' +
                        '<p style="margin:0 0 14px;color:#6B635A;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;">' +
                            'سيتم قفل الشاشة تلقائياً خلال ' +
                            '<strong id="sessionWarningCountdown" style="color:#FF4757;font-size:20px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;">' + warningSeconds + '</strong>' +
                            ' ثانية' +
                        '</p>' +
                        '<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:20px;">' +
                            '<button id="sessionWarningStayBtn" style="flex:1;min-height:46px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#D4A86A,#B78D55);color:#1A1305;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;">متابعة العمل</button>' +
                            '<button id="sessionWarningLockBtn" style="flex:1;min-height:46px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:#6B635A;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;">قفل الآن</button>' +
                        '</div>' +
                    '</div>';
                document.body.appendChild(overlay);

                overlay.querySelector('#sessionWarningStayBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
                    hideSessionWarning();
                    handleUserActivity();
                });
                overlay.querySelector('#sessionWarningLockBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
                    performSessionLock('manual_lock');
                });
            }

            overlay.style.display = 'flex';

            const countdownEl = document.getElementById('sessionWarningCountdown');
            sessionWarningCountdownTimer = setInterval(() => {
                sessionWarningRemaining -= 1;
                if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = Math.max(0, sessionWarningRemaining);
                if (sessionWarningRemaining <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(sessionWarningCountdownTimer);
                    sessionWarningCountdownTimer = null;
                }
            }, 1000);
        }

        function hideSessionWarning() {
            sessionWarningVisible = false;
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sessionWarningOverlay');
            if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'none';
            if (sessionWarningCountdownTimer) {
                clearInterval(sessionWarningCountdownTimer);
                sessionWarningCountdownTimer = null;
            }
        }

        let sessionLockInProgress = false;

        function performSessionLock(reason) {
            if (sessionLockInProgress) return;
            sessionLockInProgress = true;
            clearSessionTimers();
            hideSessionWarning();

            try {
                if (currentUser) {
                    const lockedUser = {
                        user_id: currentUser.user_id,
                        username: currentUser.username,
                        full_name: currentUser.full_name,
                        full_name_ar: currentUser.full_name_ar,
                        display_name: currentUser.display_name,
                        job_title: currentUser.job_title,
                        role: currentUser.role,
                        role_name: currentUser.role_name,
                        role_name_ar: currentUser.role_name_ar,
                        avatar_path: currentUser.avatar_path,
                        locked_at: Date.now(),
                        reason: String(reason || 'session_timeout')
                    };
                    sessionStorage.setItem('lockedUser', JSON.stringify(lockedUser));
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Failed to persist locked user:', e);
            }

            try {
                if (window.AndroidInterface && typeof window.AndroidInterface.lockSession === 'function') {
                    const raw = window.AndroidInterface.lockSession(reason || 'idle_timeout');
                    const res = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw;
                    if (!res || res.success !== true) {
                        console.warn('lockSession returned non-success:', res);
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('lockSession bridge failed:', e);
            }

            try { localStorage.removeItem('dashboardCache'); } catch (_) {}

            window.location.replace('screens/lock-screen.html');
        }

        // ================================================================
        // Android Bridge
        // ================================================================
        function initAndroidBridge() {
            if (typeof window.AndroidInterface !== 'undefined' && window.AndroidInterface !== null) {
                androidInterface = window.AndroidInterface;
                useAndroidInterface = true;
                console.log('AndroidInterface initialized');
                return true;
            }
            console.warn('AndroidInterface not available, retrying...');
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (typeof window.AndroidInterface !== 'undefined' && window.AndroidInterface !== null) {
                    androidInterface = window.AndroidInterface;
                    useAndroidInterface = true;
                    if (currentUser) {
                        loadDashboard(true);
                        renderSidebar();
                    } else {
                        loadUserFromKotlin();
                    }
                } else {
                    useAndroidInterface = false;
                    showToast('جسر Android غير متاح', 'error');
                }
            }, 500);
            return false;
        }

        async function apiCall(action, params = {}) {
            if (!useAndroidInterface || !androidInterface) {
                throw new Error('AndroidInterface غير متاح');
            }
            const safeParams = (params && typeof params === 'object') ? params : {};
            const bridgeActions = {
                exitApplication: () => androidInterface.exitApplication(),
                getCurrentUser: () => androidInterface.getCurrentUser(),
                getDashboardStats: () => androidInterface.getDashboardStats(JSON.stringify(safeParams)),
                getImageDataUrl: () => androidInterface.getImageDataUrl(
                    typeof safeParams.path === 'string' ? safeParams.path : ''
                ),
                getDueSoonDebtRemindersTyped: () => androidInterface.getDueSoonDebtRemindersTyped(JSON.stringify(safeParams)),
                sendDueSoonDebtRemindersTyped: () => androidInterface.sendDueSoonDebtRemindersTyped(JSON.stringify(safeParams)),
                getSetting: () => androidInterface.getSetting(String(safeParams.key || '')),
                setSetting: () => androidInterface.setSetting(String(safeParams.key || ''), String(safeParams.value ?? '')),
                screenExists: () => androidInterface.screenExists(
                    typeof safeParams.path === 'string' ? safeParams.path : ''
                ),
                getAllSystemSettingsMap: () => androidInterface.getAllSystemSettingsMap()
            };
            const handler = bridgeActions[action];
            if (typeof handler !== 'function') {
                return { success: false, error: `Unsupported Bridge action: ${action}` };
            }
            try {
                return handleAndroidResult(handler());
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('AndroidInterface error:', e);
                return { success: false, error: e.message || 'AndroidInterface error' };
            }
        }

        function handleAndroidResult(result) {
            if (typeof result === 'string') {
                try { result = JSON.parse(result); } catch (e) { return { success: false, error: result }; }
            }
            if (result && typeof result === 'object' && 'success' in result) return result;
            if (Array.isArray(result)) return { success: true, data: result };
            if (result && typeof result === 'object') return { success: true, data: result };
            return { success: true, data: result };
        }

        // ================================================================
        // المستخدم
        // ================================================================
        async function resolveUserAvatar(user) {
            if (!user) return;
            user.avatar_data_url = '';

            const raw = String(user.avatar_path || '').trim();
            if (!raw) return;

            if (/^data:/i.test(raw)) {
                user.avatar_data_url = raw;
                return;
            }

            if (/^(content:|file:)/i.test(raw)) {
                try {
                    const res = await apiCall('getImageDataUrl', { path: raw });
                    if (res && res.success && typeof res.data === 'string' && res.data.startsWith('data:')) {
                        user.avatar_data_url = res.data;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('Avatar resolve failed:', e);
                    user.avatar_data_url = '';
                }
                return;
            }
        }

        async function loadUserFromKotlin() {
            try {
                showLoading(true);
                const result = await apiCall('getCurrentUser');
                if (!result.success || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result.error || 'لم يتم العثور على جلسة مستخدم');
                }
                currentUser = result.data;

                await resolveUserAvatar(currentUser);

                localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(currentUser));
                updateUserInfo(currentUser);
                renderSidebar();
                await loadDashboard();
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Error loading user:', e);
                currentUser = null;
                showToast(e.message || 'تعذر تحميل المستخدم', 'error');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (window.location.pathname.endsWith('/main.html')) {
                        window.location.replace('screens/login.html');
                    }
                }, 700);
                return false;
            } finally {
                showLoading(false);
            }
        }

        function updateUserInfo(user) {
            if (!user) return;

            const nameEl = document.getElementById('userDisplayName');
            if (nameEl) {
                nameEl.textContent =
                    user.full_name_ar ||
                    user.full_name ||
                    user.display_name ||
                    user.username ||
                    '—';
            }

            const roleEl = document.getElementById('userDisplayRole');
            if (roleEl) {
                roleEl.textContent =
                    String(user.job_title || '').trim() ||
                    String(user.role_name_ar || '').trim() ||
                    String(user.role_name || '').trim() ||
                    String(user.role || '').trim() ||
                    (user.role_id ? `#${user.role_id}` : '—');
            }

            const avatarEl = document.getElementById('userAvatar');
            if (!avatarEl) return;

            const dataUrl = String(user.avatar_data_url || '').trim();
            const assetPath = String(user.avatar_path || '').trim();

            if (dataUrl) {
                avatarEl.src = dataUrl;
            } else if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(assetPath)) {
                avatarEl.src = assetPath;
            } else if (assetPath.startsWith('assets-local/')) {
                avatarEl.src = 'file:///android_asset/' + assetPath;
            } else {
                avatarEl.src = DEFAULT_AVATAR;
            }

            avatarEl.onerror = function () {
                this.onerror = null;
                this.src = DEFAULT_AVATAR;
            };
        }

        async function logout() {

            if (clockInterval) clearInterval(clockInterval);
            if (inactivityTimer) clearTimeout(inactivityTimer);
            if (sleepMoveInterval) clearInterval(sleepMoveInterval);
            clearSessionTimers();
            hideAllBubbles();
            try {
                const result = await apiCall('exitApplication');
                if (result && result.success) return;
                throw new Error((result && result.error) || 'تعذر إنهاء التطبيق');
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Exit failed:', e);
                showToast('تعذر إنهاء التطبيق', 'error');
            }
        }

        // ================================================================
        // المظهر
        // ================================================================
        function updateThemeButton(isDark) {
            const icon = document.getElementById('themeToggleIcon');
            if (!icon) return;
            icon.className = isDark ? 'fas fa-sun' : 'fas fa-moon';
            const btn = document.getElementById('themeToggleButton');
            if (btn) btn.title = isDark ? 'تفعيل الوضع الفاتح' : 'تفعيل الوضع المظلم';
        }

        function toggleTheme() {
            const html = document.documentElement;
            const isDark = html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
            const nextDark = !isDark;
            html.setAttribute('data-theme', nextDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
            localStorage.setItem('darkMode', String(nextDark));
            localStorage.setItem('fuel2-v6', nextDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
            updateThemeButton(nextDark);
            showToast(nextDark ? 'تم تفعيل الوضع المظلم' : 'تم تفعيل الوضع الفاتح', 'info');
        }

        (function initTheme() {
            const isDark = localStorage.getItem('darkMode') === 'true' ||
                          localStorage.getItem('fuel2-v6') === 'dark';
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
        })();

        async function loadMenuData() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('file:///android_asset/assets-local/menu.json');
                if (response.ok) {
                    const data = await response.json();
                    sidebarNavData = data.menu || fallbackSidebarData;
                    subPageRouteMap = data.routes || fallbackRouteMap;
                } else {
                    sidebarNavData = fallbackSidebarData;
                    subPageRouteMap = fallbackRouteMap;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Failed to load menu.json, using fallback', e);
                sidebarNavData = fallbackSidebarData;
                subPageRouteMap = fallbackRouteMap;
            }
        }

        function getSidebarData() {
            if (!currentUser) return [];
            return sidebarNavData.map(item => ({
                ...item,
                children: Array.isArray(item.children) ? item.children : []
            }));
        }

        // ================================================================
        // المفضلة والمستخدمة مؤخراً
        // ================================================================
        function addToRecent(label) {
            recent = recent.filter(item => item !== label);
            recent.unshift(label);
            if (recent.length > 10) recent.pop();
            localStorage.setItem('recent', JSON.stringify(recent));
        }

        function toggleFavorite(label) {
            if (favorites.includes(label)) {
                favorites = favorites.filter(item => item !== label);
            } else {
                favorites.push(label);
            }
            localStorage.setItem('favorites', JSON.stringify(favorites));
            renderSidebar();
        }

        function isFavorite(label) { return favorites.includes(label); }

        // ================================================================
        // بناء القائمة الجانبية
        // ================================================================
        function renderSidebar() {
            const nav = document.getElementById('sidebarNav');
            if (!nav) return;
            nav.innerHTML = '';

            const sidebarData = getSidebarData();
            if (sidebarData.length === 0) {
                const empty = document.createElement('div');
                empty.className = 'sidebar-empty-state';
                empty.textContent = currentUser ? 'لا توجد شاشات متاحة' : 'تعذر تحميل جلسة المستخدم';
                nav.appendChild(empty);
                return;
            }

            if (favorites.length > 0) {
                const title = document.createElement('div');
                title.className = 'sidebar-section-title';
                title.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-star" style="color: var(--gold);"></i> المفضلة';
                nav.appendChild(title);
                favorites.forEach(label => {
                    const item = sidebarData.find(p => p.label === label);
                    if (item) {
                        const btn = createNavItem(item, true);
                        nav.appendChild(btn);
                    }
                });
            }

            if (recent.length > 0) {
                const title = document.createElement('div');
                title.className = 'sidebar-section-title';
                title.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-clock" style="color: var(--muted);"></i> المستخدمة مؤخراً';
                nav.appendChild(title);
                recent.slice(0, 5).forEach(label => {
                    const item = sidebarData.find(p => p.label === label);
                    if (item) {
                        const btn = createNavItem(item, false);
                        nav.appendChild(btn);
                    }
                });
            }

            const allTitle = document.createElement('div');
            allTitle.className = 'sidebar-section-title';
            allTitle.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-list"></i> جميع الشاشات';
            nav.appendChild(allTitle);

            sidebarData.forEach(item => {
                const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                wrapper.className = 'nav-item-parent';

                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'nav-item';
                btn.dataset.label = item.label;
                const hasChildren = item.children && item.children.length > 0;
                btn.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="nav-icon"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></span>
                    <span class="nav-label">${item.label}</span>
                    ${hasChildren ? `<span class="nav-arrow"><i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i></span>` : ''}
                    <span style="margin-right:auto;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleFavorite('${item.label}');" title="${isFavorite(item.label) ? 'إزالة من المفضلة' : 'إضافة إلى المفضلة'}">
                        <i class="fas ${isFavorite(item.label) ? 'fa-star' : 'fa-star-o'}" style="color:${isFavorite(item.label) ? 'var(--gold)' : 'rgba(26,19,5,.5)'};"></i>
                    </span>
                `;

                if (hasChildren) {
                    btn.onclick = function(e) {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        const childContainer = this.parentElement.querySelector('.nav-children');
                        const arrow = this.querySelector('.nav-arrow');
                        if (childContainer) {
                            childContainer.classList.toggle('open');
                            if (arrow) arrow.classList.toggle('open');
                        }
                    };
                } else {
                    btn.onclick = function(e) {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        const route = subPageRouteMap[item.label] || '/';
                        addToRecent(item.label);
                        navigateTo(route);
                    };
                }
                wrapper.appendChild(btn);

                if (hasChildren) {
                    const childContainer = document.createElement('div');
                    childContainer.className = 'nav-children';
                    item.children.forEach(child => {
                        const childBtn = document.createElement('button');
                        childBtn.className = 'nav-child';
                        childBtn.innerHTML = `
                            <span class="child-icon"><i class="fas fa-chevron-left"></i></span>
                            <span>${child}</span>
                            <span style="margin-right:auto;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleFavorite('${child}');" title="${isFavorite(child) ? 'إزالة من المفضلة' : 'إضافة إلى المفضلة'}">
                                <i class="fas ${isFavorite(child) ? 'fa-star' : 'fa-star-o'}" style="color:${isFavorite(child) ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--muted)'};"></i>
                            </span>
                        `;
                        childBtn.onclick = function(e) {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            const route = subPageRouteMap[child] || null;
                            if (route) {
                                addToRecent(child);
                                navigateTo(route);
                            } else {
                                showToast('هذه الشاشة قيد التطوير', 'info');
                            }
                        };
                        childContainer.appendChild(childBtn);
                    });
                    wrapper.appendChild(childContainer);
                }
                nav.appendChild(wrapper);
            });

            const pinned = localStorage.getItem('sidebar-pinned') === 'true';
            if (pinned) {
                document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('pinned');
                document.getElementById('pinBtn').classList.add('pinned');
            }
            const compact = localStorage.getItem('sidebar-compact') === 'true';
            if (compact) {
                document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('compact');
                document.getElementById('compactBtn').classList.add('active-mode');
            }

            syncElasticSvgWidth();
        }

        function createNavItem(item, isFav) {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.className = 'nav-item';
            if (isFav) {
                btn.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold2), var(--gold))';
            }
            btn.dataset.label = item.label;
            const hasChildren = item.children && item.children.length > 0;
            btn.innerHTML = `
                <span class="nav-icon"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></span>
                <span class="nav-label">${item.label}</span>
                ${hasChildren ? `<span class="nav-arrow"><i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i></span>` : ''}
                <span style="margin-right:auto;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleFavorite('${item.label}');" title="${isFavorite(item.label) ? 'إزالة من المفضلة' : 'إضافة إلى المفضلة'}">
                    <i class="fas ${isFavorite(item.label) ? 'fa-star' : 'fa-star-o'}" style="color:${isFavorite(item.label) ? '#1A1305' : 'rgba(26,19,5,.5)'};"></i>
                </span>
            `;
            btn.onclick = function(e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (hasChildren) {
                    const parent = this.parentElement;
                    if (parent && parent.classList.contains('nav-item-parent')) {
                        const childContainer = parent.querySelector('.nav-children');
                        const arrow = this.querySelector('.nav-arrow');
                        if (childContainer) {
                            childContainer.classList.toggle('open');
                            if (arrow) arrow.classList.toggle('open');
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    const route = subPageRouteMap[item.label] || '/';
                    addToRecent(item.label);
                    navigateTo(route);
                }
            };
            return btn;
        }

        function filterSidebar(event) {
            const query = event.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
            const items = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item-parent');
            let found = false;
            if (!query) {
                items.forEach(p => { p.style.display = ''; });
                return;
            }
            items.forEach(parent => {
                const label = parent.querySelector('.nav-label');
                const text = label ? label.textContent.toLowerCase() : '';
                const match = text.includes(query);
                parent.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
                if (match) found = true;
                if (match) {
                    const children = parent.querySelector('.nav-children');
                    const arrow = parent.querySelector('.nav-arrow');
                    if (children) children.classList.add('open');
                    if (arrow) arrow.classList.toggle('open', true);
                }
            });
            const emptyState = document.querySelector('.sidebar-empty-state');
            if (!found && !emptyState) {
                const msg = document.createElement('div');
                msg.className = 'sidebar-empty-state';
                msg.textContent = 'لم يتم العثور على نتائج';
                document.getElementById('sidebarNav').appendChild(msg);
            } else if (found && emptyState) {
                emptyState.remove();
            }
        }

        // ================================================================
        // التحكم في القائمة الجانبية
        // ================================================================
        function openSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
            const sideTab = document.getElementById('sideTab');
            if (isSidebarAnimating || sidebar.classList.contains('open')) return;

            syncElasticSvgWidth();
            sidebar.classList.add('open');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');
            if (sideTab) sideTab.classList.add('hidden');

            animateElasticPath(currentLeadX, SIDEBAR_OPEN, 700);
        }

        function closeSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const overlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
            const sideTab = document.getElementById('sideTab');
            if (isSidebarAnimating || !sidebar.classList.contains('open')) return;

            sidebar.classList.remove('open');
            if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');
            if (sideTab) sideTab.classList.remove('hidden');

            animateElasticPath(currentLeadX, SIDEBAR_CLOSED, 620);
        }

        function toggleSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            if (sidebar.classList.contains('open')) {
                closeSidebar();
            } else {
                openSidebar();
            }
        }

        function togglePinSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const pinBtn = document.getElementById('pinBtn');
            const isPinned = sidebar.classList.toggle('pinned');
            pinBtn.classList.toggle('pinned');
            localStorage.setItem('sidebar-pinned', isPinned ? 'true' : 'false');
            if (isPinned) openSidebar();
            else closeSidebar();
        }

        function toggleCompactSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const btn = document.getElementById('compactBtn');
            const isCompact = sidebar.classList.toggle('compact');
            btn.classList.toggle('active-mode');
            localStorage.setItem('sidebar-compact', isCompact ? 'true' : 'false');
            setTimeout(syncElasticSvgWidth, 50);
            showToast(isCompact ? 'تم تفعيل الوضع المضغوط' : 'تم إلغاء الوضع المضغوط', 'info');
        }

        function closePanels() {
            closeSidebar();
        }

        // ================================================================
        // Drag Gestures
        // ================================================================
        let dragState = {
            active: false,
            target: null,
            startX: 0,
            startY: 0,
            currentX: 0,
            currentY: 0,
            direction: null
        };

        function beginDrag(touch, target) {
            if (isSidebarAnimating) return;
            dragState.active = true;
            dragState.target = target;
            dragState.startX = touch.clientX;
            dragState.startY = touch.clientY;
            dragState.currentX = touch.clientX;
            dragState.currentY = touch.clientY;
            dragState.direction = null;
        }

        function moveDrag(e) {
            if (!dragState.active) return;
            const touch = e.touches[0];
            if (!touch) return;

            dragState.currentX = touch.clientX;
            dragState.currentY = touch.clientY;

            const dx = dragState.currentX - dragState.startX;
            const dy = dragState.currentY - dragState.startY;

            if (!dragState.direction) {
                if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) + 4) {
                    dragState.direction = 'horizontal';
                } else if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) + 4) {
                    dragState.direction = 'vertical';
                } else {
                    return;
                }
            }

            if (dragState.direction !== 'horizontal') return;

            e.preventDefault();

            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const width = sidebar.offsetWidth || 320;
            let leadX;

            if (dragState.target === 'tab') {
                const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -dx / width));
                leadX = SIDEBAR_CLOSED - (SIDEBAR_CLOSED * progress);
            } else if (dragState.target === 'sidebar') {
                const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, dx / width));
                leadX = SIDEBAR_OPEN + (SIDEBAR_CLOSED - SIDEBAR_OPEN) * progress;
            } else {
                return;
            }

            const normalizedProgress = 1 - (leadX / SIDEBAR_CLOSED);
            const arcRadius = Math.sin(normalizedProgress * Math.PI) * 55;

            const pathEl = document.getElementById('sPath');
            pathEl.setAttribute('d', createElasticD(leadX, arcRadius));
            currentLeadX = leadX;
        }

        function endDrag() {
            if (!dragState.active) return;
            const target = dragState.target;
            const direction = dragState.direction;
            const dx = dragState.currentX - dragState.startX;

            dragState.active = false;
            dragState.target = null;
            dragState.direction = null;

            if (direction !== 'horizontal') return;

            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            const width = sidebar.offsetWidth || 320;
            const threshold = width * 0.28;

            if (target === 'tab') {
                if (-dx > threshold) {
                    sidebar.classList.add('open');
                    document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.add('active');
                    document.getElementById('sideTab').classList.add('hidden');
                    animateElasticPath(currentLeadX, SIDEBAR_OPEN, 420);
                } else {
                    animateElasticPath(currentLeadX, SIDEBAR_CLOSED, 420);
                }
            } else if (target === 'sidebar') {
                if (dx > threshold) {
                    sidebar.classList.remove('open');
                    document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.remove('active');
                    document.getElementById('sideTab').classList.remove('hidden');
                    animateElasticPath(currentLeadX, SIDEBAR_CLOSED, 420);
                } else {
                    animateElasticPath(currentLeadX, SIDEBAR_OPEN, 420);
                }
            }
        }

        function initDragGestures() {
            const sideTab = document.getElementById('sideTab');
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');

            if (sideTab) {
                sideTab.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                    if (sidebar.classList.contains('open') || isSidebarAnimating) return;
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    if (touch) beginDrag(touch, 'tab');
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            if (sidebar) {
                sidebar.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
                    if (!sidebar.classList.contains('open') || isSidebarAnimating) return;
                    const tag = (e.target.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
                    if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'button' || tag === 'a' || tag === 'textarea' ||
                        tag === 'select' || e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('input')) {
                        return;
                    }
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    if (touch) beginDrag(touch, 'sidebar');
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            document.addEventListener('touchmove', moveDrag, { passive: false });
            document.addEventListener('touchend', endDrag, { passive: true });
            document.addEventListener('touchcancel', endDrag, { passive: true });
        }

        // ================================================================
        // التنقل
        // ================================================================
        async function navigateTo(url) {
            if (typeof url !== 'string' || !url.trim()) {
                showToast('مسار الشاشة غير صالح', 'error');
                return;
            }
            if (url === 'dashboard') {
                if (!currentUser) { showToast('لا توجد جلسة مستخدم', 'error'); return; }
                closePanels();
                closeCommandPalette();
                return;
            }

            // Keep query/hash context for screen-specific drill-downs, but validate
            // only the actual asset path with AndroidInterface.screenExists.
            const rawTarget = url.trim();
            const suffixIndex = rawTarget.search(/[?#]/);
            const suffix = suffixIndex >= 0 ? rawTarget.substring(suffixIndex) : '';
            let screenPath = suffixIndex >= 0 ? rawTarget.substring(0, suffixIndex) : rawTarget;
            if (screenPath.startsWith('/')) screenPath = screenPath.substring(1);
            if (!screenPath.startsWith('screens/')) screenPath = 'screens/' + screenPath;
            if (!screenPath.endsWith('.html')) screenPath += '.html';
            const targetUrl = screenPath + suffix;

            if (!currentUser) { showToast('لا توجد جلسة مستخدم', 'error'); return; }

            closePanels();
            closeCommandPalette();

            try {
                const result = await apiCall('screenExists', { path: screenPath });
                if (!result.success) {
                    showToast(result.error || 'تعذر التحقق من الشاشة', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                if (result.data === false) {
                    showToast('الشاشة غير موجودة في نسخة التطبيق الحالية', 'error');
                    return;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Screen check failed:', e);
                showToast('تعذر التحقق من جاهزية الشاشة', 'error');
                return;
            }
            showLoading(true);
            window.location.href = targetUrl;
        }

        // ================================================================
        // Command Palette
        // ================================================================
        function openCommandPalette() {
            const overlay = document.getElementById('commandPaletteOverlay');
            overlay.classList.add('show');
            const input = document.getElementById('commandPaletteInput');
            input.value = '';
            input.focus();
            renderCommandPaletteResults('');
        }

        function closeCommandPalette() {
            document.getElementById('commandPaletteOverlay').classList.remove('show');
            document.getElementById('commandPaletteInput').blur();
        }

        function renderCommandPaletteResults(query) {
            const container = document.getElementById('commandPaletteResults');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const sidebarData = getSidebarData();
            const flatItems = [];
            sidebarData.forEach(item => {
                flatItems.push({ label: item.label, icon: item.icon, parent: null });
                if (item.children && item.children.length) {
                    item.children.forEach(child => {
                        flatItems.push({ label: child, icon: 'fa-chevron-left', parent: item.label });
                    });
                }
            });

            const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
            const filtered = q === '' ? flatItems : flatItems.filter(item =>
                item.label.includes(q) || (item.parent && item.parent.includes(q))
            );

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-results">لا توجد نتائج مطابقة</div>';
                return;
            }

            filtered.slice(0, 15).forEach(item => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'result-item';
                const icon = item.icon || 'fa-circle';
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <i class="fas ${icon}"></i>
                    <span class="result-label">${item.label}</span>
                    ${item.parent ? `<span class="result-path">${item.parent}</span>` : ''}
                `;
                div.onclick = function() {
                    let route = subPageRouteMap[item.label];
                    if (route) {
                        addToRecent(item.label);
                        navigateTo(route);
                    } else {
                        const parentItem = sidebarData.find(p => p.label === item.label);
                        if (parentItem && parentItem.children && parentItem.children.length) {
                            const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
                            for (let btn of navItems) {
                                if (btn.dataset.label === item.label) {
                                    btn.click();
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            closeCommandPalette();
                        } else {
                            showToast('هذه الشاشة غير متاحة', 'info');
                        }
                    }
                    closeCommandPalette();
                };
                container.appendChild(div);
            });

            const first = container.querySelector('.result-item');
            if (first) first.classList.add('active');
        }

        let mainDueReminderRows = [];
        let mainDueReminderDeferred = false;

        function ensureMainDueReminderUI() {
            if (!document.getElementById('mainDueReminderOverlay')) {
                const o = document.createElement('div');
                o.id = 'mainDueReminderOverlay';
                o.className = 'due-reminder-overlay';
                o.setAttribute('role','presentation');
                o.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target===o)closeMainDueReminderNotice();});
                o.innerHTML = `<div class="due-reminder-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="mainDueReminderTitle"><div class="due-reminder-heading"><h3 id="mainDueReminderTitle">🔔 مستحقات العملاء تقترب</h3><button type="button" class="due-reminder-close" aria-label="إغلاق" onclick="closeMainDueReminderNotice()"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></button></div><p>يوجد عملاء لديهم فواتير آجلة اقترب موعد استحقاقها. يمكنك إرسال تذكير يدوي الآن أو تفعيل الإرسال الآلي المستمر.</p><div class="due-auto-toggle"><label><input id="mainDueReminderMode_auto" type="checkbox" onchange="setMainDebtReminderMode('auto',this.checked)"> إرسال SMS آلياً</label><label><input id="mainDueReminderMode_manual" type="checkbox" onchange="setMainDebtReminderMode('manual',this.checked)"> إرسال SMS يدوياً</label><label><input id="mainDueReminderMode_local" type="checkbox" onchange="setMainDebtReminderMode('local',this.checked)"> إشعار محلي فقط</label></div><div id="mainDueReminderFeedback" class="due-reminder-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><div class="due-reminder-actions"><button class="due-view" onclick="openMainDueReminderDetails()">إطلاع</button><button class="due-delay" onclick="deferMainDueReminder()">تأجيل</button><button class="due-cancel" onclick="cancelMainDueReminderNotice()">إلغاء</button><button id="mainDueReminderSendButton" class="due-ok" onclick="approveMainDueReminders()">إرسال التذكيرات الآن</button></div></div>`;
                document.body.appendChild(o);
            }
            if (!document.getElementById('mainDueDetailModal')) {
                const o = document.createElement('div');
                o.id = 'mainDueDetailModal';
                o.className = 'due-detail-modal';
                o.innerHTML = `<div class="due-detail-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="تفاصيل مستحقات العملاء"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px"><h3>العملاء الذين سيصلهم التذكير</h3><button class="glass-btn" onclick="closeMainDueReminderDetails()" aria-label="إغلاق">✕</button></div><div id="mainDueDetailContent"></div></div>`;
                document.body.appendChild(o);
            }
            const container=document.getElementById('bubbleContainer')||createBubbleContainer();
            if (!document.getElementById('mainDueReminderBubble')) {
                const b=document.createElement('button');
                b.type='button'; b.id='mainDueReminderBubble';
                b.className='notification-bubble due-reminder-notification-bubble';
                b.style.display='none';
                b.innerHTML='<i class="fas fa-comment-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="due-bubble-count" aria-hidden="true">0</span>';
                b.title='مستحقات محققة'; b.setAttribute('aria-label','مستحقات محققة - فتح تذكيرات العملاء');

        function setMainDueReminderFeedback(message,isError=true) {
            const el=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderFeedback');
            if(!el)return;
            el.textContent=message||'';
            el.classList.toggle('show',!!message);
            el.style.borderColor=isError?'rgba(220,38,38,.28)':'rgba(5,150,105,.3)';
            el.style.background=isError?'rgba(220,38,38,.08)':'rgba(5,150,105,.08)';
            el.style.color=isError?'var(--danger)':'var(--success)';
        }

        function dueReminderRefreshStorageKey() {
            const userId = currentUser?.id ?? currentUser?.user_id ?? currentUser?.userId ?? 'anonymous';
            const stationId = currentUser?.station_id ?? currentUser?.stationId ?? 'default';
            return `mainDueReminderRefreshAt:${String(stationId)}:${String(userId)}`;
        }

        function shouldRefreshMainDueReminders(now = Date.now()) {
            try {
                const last = Number.parseInt(localStorage.getItem(dueReminderRefreshStorageKey()) || '0', 10);
                return !Number.isFinite(last) || last <= 0 || now - last >= DUE_REMINDER_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS;
            } catch (_) {
                // If storage is unavailable, retain one check per WebView instance.
                return !window.__mainDueReminderRefreshAt || now - window.__mainDueReminderRefreshAt >= DUE_REMINDER_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS;
            }
        }

        function markMainDueRemindersRefreshed(now = Date.now()) {
            window.__mainDueReminderRefreshAt = now;
            try { localStorage.setItem(dueReminderRefreshStorageKey(), String(now)); } catch (_) {}
        }


        async function loadMainDebtReminderModes() {
            const keys={auto:'debt_due_auto_sms_enabled',manual:'debt_due_manual_sms_enabled',local:'debt_due_local_notification_enabled'};
            const modes={};
            for(const [mode,key] of Object.entries(keys)){
                const result=await apiCall('getSetting',{key});
                modes[mode]=result.success&&String(result.value??'0')==='1';
                const el=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderMode_'+mode);
                if(el)el.checked=modes[mode];
            }
            window.__debtReminderModes=modes;
            const send=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderSendButton');
            if(send)send.style.display=modes.manual?'inline-flex':'none';
            return modes;
        }
        async function setMainDebtReminderMode(mode,enabled){
            const keys={auto:'debt_due_auto_sms_enabled',manual:'debt_due_manual_sms_enabled',local:'debt_due_local_notification_enabled'};
            const key=keys[mode];if(!key)return;
            const checkbox=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderMode_'+mode);
            if(checkbox)checkbox.disabled=true;
            try{
                const result=await apiCall('setSetting',{key,value:enabled?'1':'0'});
                if(!result.success)throw new Error(result.error||result.message||'تعذر حفظ وضع التذكير');
                const verify=await apiCall('getSetting',{key});
                if(!verify.success||String(verify.value??'0')!==(enabled?'1':'0'))throw new Error('لم يتم التحقق من حفظ وضع التذكير');
                if(mode==='auto'){
                    window.__debtReminderModes=Object.assign({},window.__debtReminderModes||{},{auto:enabled});
                    const dashboardSetting=document.getElementById('mainDueAutoSmsEnabled');
                    if(dashboardSetting)dashboardSetting.checked=enabled;
                    if(enabled)await closeMainDueReminderNotice();
                }
                setMainDueReminderFeedback('',false);
            }catch(error){
                if(checkbox)checkbox.checked=!enabled;
                setMainDueReminderFeedback(error.message||'تعذر حفظ وضع التذكير');
            }finally{if(checkbox)checkbox.disabled=false;}
        }
        async function persistMainDueReminderDecision(action,mode='manual'){
            const eligible=mainDueReminderRows.filter(r=>String(r.event_id||'').trim()&&Number(r.customer_party_id)>0&&Number(r.total_outstanding)>0&&Number(r.days_remaining)>=0&&Number(r.days_remaining)<=10);
            if(!eligible.length)throw new Error('لا توجد مستحقات قريبة صالحة لتحديث التذكير.');
            for(const row of eligible){
                const result=await apiCall('updateDebtReminderInteractionTyped',{
                    event_id:String(row.event_id).trim(),customer_party_id:Number(row.customer_party_id),
                    due_date:String(row.nearest_due_date||row.due_date||'').trim(),action,mode
                });
                if(!result||!result.success)throw new Error(result?.error||result?.message||'تعذر حفظ قرار التذكير');
            }
        }

        async function loadMainDueAutoSmsSetting() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('mainDueAutoSmsEnabled');
            if (!checkbox) return;
            try {
                const result = await apiCall('getSetting', { key: 'debt_due_auto_sms_enabled' });
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error || 'تعذر قراءة إعداد الإرسال الآلي');
                checkbox.checked = String(result.value ?? '0') === '1';
            } catch (error) {
                checkbox.checked = false;
                console.warn('Main due auto-SMS setting:', error);
            }
        }

        async function setMainDueAutoSmsEnabled(enabled) {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('mainDueAutoSmsEnabled');
            if (checkbox) checkbox.disabled = true;
            try {
                const result = await apiCall('setSetting', { key: 'debt_due_auto_sms_enabled', value: enabled ? '1' : '0' });
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error || result.message || 'تعذر حفظ إعداد الإرسال الآلي');
                const verified = await apiCall('getSetting', { key: 'debt_due_auto_sms_enabled' });
                if (!verified.success || String(verified.value ?? '0') !== (enabled ? '1' : '0')) {
                    throw new Error('لم يتم التحقق من حفظ إعداد الإرسال الآلي في SQLite');
                }
                if (checkbox) checkbox.checked = enabled;
                showToast(enabled
                    ? 'تم تفعيل التذكير الآلي. سيعمل في الخلفية وفق قيود نظام Android.'
                    : 'تم إيقاف التذكير الآلي.', 'success');
            } catch (error) {
                if (checkbox) checkbox.checked = !enabled;
                showToast(error.message || 'تعذر تحديث إعداد التذكير الآلي', 'error');
            } finally {
                if (checkbox) checkbox.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function refreshDebtReminderSendSuccess() {
            try {
                const result = await apiCall('consumeSuccessfulDebtReminderSmsTyped', {});
                if (!result.success) return;
                const count = Number(result.data?.sent_count || 0);
                if (count > 0) showToast(`تم إرسال ${count} من رسائل تذكير الديون بنجاح.`, 'success');
            } catch (e) { console.warn('Debt reminder send confirmation:', e); }
        }

        async function refreshMainDueReminders() {
            ensureMainDueReminderUI();
            await loadMainDueAutoSmsSetting();
            try {
                const result = await apiCall('getDueSoonDebtRemindersTyped', { days: 10 });
                if (!result.success) return false;
                mainDueReminderRows = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data : [];
                await loadMainDebtReminderModes();
                const dueSoon = mainDueReminderRows.filter(r =>
                    Number(r.total_outstanding) > 0 && Number(r.days_remaining) >= 0 &&
                    Number(r.days_remaining) <= 10 &&
                    !['dismissed','viewed','queued','sent','deferred'].includes(r.interaction_action)
                );
                const b=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderBubble');
                if(b){
                    const shouldShow=dueSoon.length>0;
                    const wasHidden=b.style.display==='none';
                    b.style.display=shouldShow?'flex':'none';
                    b.title=`مستحقات محققة: ${dueSoon.length}`;
                    b.setAttribute('aria-label',`مستحقات محققة: ${dueSoon.length} مستحقات قريبة`);
                    const countBadge=b.querySelector('.due-bubble-count');if(countBadge)countBadge.textContent=String(dueSoon.length);
                    if(shouldShow&&wasHidden){
                        const sources=['card-customer-debts','card-due-invoices'].map(id=>document.getElementById(id)).filter(Boolean);
                        animateBubbleFromCards(b,sources);
                    }
                }
                const modes=window.__debtReminderModes||{};
                const deferred=mainDueReminderRows.some(r=>r.interaction_action==='deferred');
                const reminderBubble=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderBubble');
                if(reminderBubble){
                    reminderBubble.classList.toggle('is-deferred',deferred);
                    if(deferred&&!dueSoon.length)reminderBubble.style.display='flex';
                }
                if (dueSoon.length && !mainDueReminderDeferred && (modes.manual||modes.local) &&
                    sessionStorage.getItem('mainDueReminderShownDate') !== businessDayDate()) {
                    sessionStorage.setItem('mainDueReminderShownDate', businessDayDate());
                    openMainDueReminderNotice();
                }
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Main due reminders:', e);
                return false;
            }
        }

        function openMainDueReminderNotice() {
            ensureMainDueReminderUI();
            const overlay=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderOverlay');
            if(overlay) overlay.classList.add('show');
            setMainDueReminderFeedback('',false);
            document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
        }
        async function closeMainDueReminderNotice() {
            document.getElementById('mainDueReminderOverlay')?.classList.remove('show');
            if(!document.getElementById('mainDueDetailModal')?.classList.contains('show')) document.body.style.overflow='';
        }
        async function cancelMainDueReminderNotice() {
            const buttons=document.querySelectorAll('#mainDueReminderOverlay .due-reminder-actions button');
            buttons.forEach(button=>button.disabled=true);
            try {
                // "إلغاء" يوقف SMS الآلي واليدوي ويُبقي التذكير كإشعار محلي فقط.
                const modes={auto:'0',manual:'0',local:'1'};
                for(const [mode,value] of Object.entries(modes)){
                    const key={auto:'debt_due_auto_sms_enabled',manual:'debt_due_manual_sms_enabled',local:'debt_due_local_notification_enabled'}[mode];
                    const saved=await apiCall('setSetting',{key,value});
                    if(!saved.success)throw new Error(saved.error||saved.message||'تعذر تحويل التذكير إلى إشعار محلي');
                    const checked=await apiCall('getSetting',{key});
                    if(!checked.success||String(checked.value??'0')!==value)throw new Error('تعذر التحقق من إعداد الإشعار المحلي');
                }
                await persistMainDueReminderDecision('dismissed','local');
                mainDueReminderDeferred=false;
                const bubble=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderBubble');
                if(bubble)bubble.style.display='none';
                await closeMainDueReminderNotice();
                await refreshMainDueReminders();
            } catch(e) { setMainDueReminderFeedback(e.message||'تعذر إلغاء التذكير'); }
            finally { buttons.forEach(button=>button.disabled=false); }
        }
        async function deferMainDueReminder() {
            const buttons=document.querySelectorAll('#mainDueReminderOverlay .due-reminder-actions button');
            buttons.forEach(button=>button.disabled=true);
            try {
                await persistMainDueReminderDecision('deferred','local');
                mainDueReminderDeferred=true;
                await closeMainDueReminderNotice();
                const bubble=document.getElementById('mainDueReminderBubble');
                if(bubble){bubble.classList.remove('deferred-pulse');void bubble.offsetWidth;bubble.classList.add('deferred-pulse');bubble.classList.add('show');bubble.style.display='flex';}
            } catch(e) { setMainDueReminderFeedback(e.message||'تعذر تأجيل التذكير'); }
            finally { buttons.forEach(button=>button.disabled=false); }
        }
        async function approveMainDueReminders() {
            closeMainDueReminderNotice();
            apiCall('sendDueSoonDebtRemindersTyped', { days: 10 })
                .then(r => {
                    if (!r.success) throw new Error(r.error || r.message || 'تعذر إرسال التذكيرات');
                    showToast(`تمت إضافة ${r.data?.queued_count || 0} رسالة إلى طابور SMS`, 'success');
                    document.getElementById('mainDueReminderBubble')?.classList.remove('show');
                    refreshMainDueReminders();
                })
                .catch(e => showToast(e.message || 'تعذر إرسال التذكيرات', 'error'));
        }
        function escapeMainDueReminderHtml(value) {
            return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
                '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
            })[character]);
        }
        function openMainDueReminderDetails() {
            ensureMainDueReminderUI();
            const rows = mainDueReminderRows.filter(r =>
                Number(r.total_outstanding) > 0 && Number(r.days_remaining) >= 0 &&
                Number(r.days_remaining) <= 10
            );
            document.getElementById('mainDueDetailContent').innerHTML = rows.length
                ? `<div class="due-detail-table-wrap"><table class="due-detail-table"><thead><tr><th>العميل</th><th>الهاتف</th><th>الدين القريب</th><th>إجمالي غير المسدد</th><th>الاستحقاق</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(r => `<tr><td>${escapeMainDueReminderHtml(String(r.customer_name || '---'))}</td><td dir="ltr">${escapeMainDueReminderHtml(String(r.phone || '---'))}</td><td class="due-red">${Number(r.due_soon_amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US')} ${escapeMainDueReminderHtml(CURRENCY)}</td><td class="due-blue">${Number(r.total_outstanding || 0).toLocaleString('en-US')} ${escapeMainDueReminderHtml(CURRENCY)}</td><td>${escapeMainDueReminderHtml(String(r.nearest_due_date || '---'))}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`
                : '<div style="padding:30px;text-align:center">لا توجد مستحقات مؤهلة حالياً.</div>';
            document.getElementById('mainDueDetailModal').classList.add('show');
        }
        function closeMainDueReminderDetails() {
            document.getElementById('mainDueDetailModal')?.classList.remove('show');
        }
